title: Brand Manager — Brand Research & Insights
description:
**About Snapmint:** 




 Founded by IIT Bombay alumni (Nalin Agrawal, Anil Gelra, Abhineet Sawa), Snapmint is building India’s most loved payment brand. We pioneered Pay in 3 through UPI and are also home to India’s leading 0% EMI e\-commerce app — giving millions of Indians the freedom to shop now and pay in monthly instalments, with no extra cost and no credit card required.
 



  





 Today, Snapmint has crossed 50M\+ app downloads and is the preferred payment partner for 2,000\+ leading consumer brands, including Zepto, ixigo, Adani, District Store, Titan and many more. We’re on a mission to make fair, transparent credit accessible to Young India \- and make payments simple, enjoyable and worry\-free.
 



  





 Headquartered in Mumbai, with offices across major metros including Bengaluru, Gurugram, Delhi and Jaipur, we’re building at the intersection of commerce, credit, technology and culture. If you want to work on a product used by millions, build a brand people genuinely love, and help redefine how the next generation of India pays and spends you’ll fit right in.
 



 Come build Snapmint and help us change how India pays.
 



  





**The Role:** 




 We’re looking for a Brand Manager – Research \& Insights to build and own Snapmint’s brand intelligence function. You’ll bring together consumer research, brand tracking, competitive intelligence and data to help Snapmint better understand its consumers and make sharper brand and business decisions.
 



  





**Role Title:** 
 Brand Manager — Brand Research \& Insights
 



**Department:** 
 Marketing
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Fulltime
 



**Experience:** 
 3 \-5 Yrs.
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



**Working Model:** 
 Work from Office – 5 Days per Week
 



**Entity:** 
 Snapmint Credit Advisory Private Limited
 



  





**What You Own:** 



* Build a deep understanding of Snapmint’s consumers — personas, needs, behaviours, motivations and attitudes.
* Own quarterly brand tracking and brand health across awareness, consideration, preference, recall, trust and key brand metrics.
* Lead qualitative and quantitative consumer research across brand, product, communication and CX.
* Measure campaign effectiveness and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Track competitors, category trends and emerging consumer opportunities.
* Turn research and data into sharp, actionable insights for Brand, Product, Marketing and Business teams.
* Manage research agencies, partners and vendors end\-to\-end.
* Build a central consumer \& brand knowledge base for Snapmint.



  





**What You Bring:** 



* 3–5\+ years in Brand Strategy, Consumer Insights, Market Research or Brand Research.
* Strong understanding of qualitative \& quantitative research and brand measurement.
* Highly analytical and data\-driven, with the ability to turn data into clear business actions.
* Strong strategic thinking and storytelling skills.
* Experience in a high\-growth, B2C technology or consumer business.
* Naturally curious, with a strong ability to uncover the “why” behind consumer behaviour.



  





**Good to Have:** 



* Graduate from a Tier\-1 institution.
* MBA in Marketing, Strategy or a related field.
* Experience building brand tracking/health frameworks from scratch.
* Experience in fintech, payments, e\-commerce or consumer internet.
* Experience managing research agencies and external research partners.



  





**Why Snapmint:** 



* Be Part of a 10X–100X Journey \- Help build and scale and be part of a high\-growth story.
* Raise the Bar \- Learn from people who raise the bar.
* Solve Hard Problems \- Work on meaningful, high\-impact challenges.
* Own the Outcome \- Take ownership and make things happen.
* Move Fast, Build Fast \- Turn ideas into action, not backlogs.
* Make Real Impact \- See your work reach millions of customers.
* Grow with Snapmint \- Take on bigger challenges as we scale.

title: MANAGER ENGINEERING AND BUSINESS EXCELLENCE - Business Analysis
description:

 8\-10 Years

 Healthcare/ HealthTech

 Full\-Time
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an experienced Senior Business Analyst with strong Healthcare/ HealthTech experience to support delivery, maintenance and continuous improvement of digital healthcare platforms.
   

  

 The candidate should have strong exposure to both Indian and international healthcare ecosystems and be capable of working closely with business stakeholders, healthcare operations teams, technology teams, and vendors to ensure successful delivery and maintenance of digital healthcare solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Business Analysis \& Demand Management**
* Analyse and triage business, operational, production and enhancement requests

* Gather and document requirements through workshops, stakeholder discussions and process analysis
* Create user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications and process flows

* Distinguish between defects, service requests, enhancements, features and process improvements


**Backlog \& Functional Readiness**

* Support UAT and defect triage, distinguishing defects from requirement gaps or enhancements
* Ensure business validation/sign\-off before release and support post\-release validation


**Production Support \& Continuous Improvement**
* Provide functional analysis and business impact assessment for production issues
* Distinguish defects, process gaps, configuration issues and enhancement opportunities
* Support maintenance backlog prioritization and resolution
* Identify recurring issues, opportunities for process improvement, automation and better user experience


**Required Experience \& Skills**
* 8?10 years of experience in Business Analysis, Functional Analysis, Product Analysis or related roles
* Minimum 5 years in Healthcare / HealthTech
* Experience across both project delivery and BAU/ application maintenance
* Strong Agile/Scrum experience
* Experience managing requirements across multiple stakeholder groups and cross\-functional tech teams
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and communication skills
* Ability to challenge ambiguity and drive requirements to closure
* Strong ownership, follow\-through and attention to detail


**Functional Skills**
* Requirement Elicitation \& Analysis
* User Stories \& Acceptance Criteria
* Business Process Mapping
* Gap \& Impact Analysis
* Backlog Refinement / Definition of Ready
* Dependency Management
* UAT \& Business Validation
* Production Support
* Change \& Release Management
* Stakeholder Management
* Process Improvement


**Tools**
* Jira
* MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint
* Process\-mapping tools such as Visio/ Lucidchart/ Draw.io.
* Figma (Functional Flows)


**Key Success Measures**
* High\-quality requirements with minimal rework after sprint commencement
* Strong backlog refinement and story readiness before sprint commitment
* Early identification and escalation of dependencies
* Reduction in requirement\-driven defects, UAT issues and sprint spillovers
* Effective UAT and timely business sign\-off
* Timely functional support for production issues and enhancements
* Improved stakeholder satisfaction and clarity between business and technology teams
* Contribution to continuous improvement of healthcare platforms and operational processes


**Ideal Candidate**
* A healthcare\-focused Senior Business Analyst who can independently drive the journey from:


 Business Problem ? Analysis ? Requirement ? Dependencies ? Backlog Readiness ? Delivery Support ? UAT ? Business Acceptance ? Release ? Continuous Improvement
   

  

* The candidate should be comfortable challenging incomplete requirements, identifying risks before they impact delivery, and ensuring the team does not commit to work that is not sufficiently understood


**Core expectation**
 Convert business demand into clear, validated and delivery\-ready requirements while improving the quality, stability and business value of healthcare platforms
   

  

**Reporting To**
 Product Manager / Product Owner / Delivery Manager
   

  

**Works With**
 Business \& Clinical Stakeholders, Healthcare Operations, Product, Delivery, Development, QA, Architecture, UX, Support and External Vendors

title: Strategy Analyst
description:
**About Joveo** 




 As the global leader in AI\-powered recruitment marketing, we are transforming talent attraction and recruitment media buying for the world’s largest and smartest employers, staffing businesses, RPOs, and recruitment advertising agencies.
 



  





 The Joveo platform enables businesses to attract, source, engage, and hire the most relevant candidates on time, within their budget. Powering millions of jobs every day, our data\-driven recruitment marketing platform uses advanced data science and machine learning to dynamically manage and optimize talent sourcing and applications across all online channels while providing real\-time insights at every step of the job seeker journey, from click to hire.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 Most internships have you fetching coffee or doing mindless data entry. This is not one of them. At Joveo, the Strategic Initiatives team operates like a startup within a scale\-up. We research, build, and scale new global supply channels and revenue streams from zero. We are looking for a
 **Growth \& Strategy Intern** 
 to work directly with leadership to solve complex business problems, optimize go\-to\-market (GTM) strategies, and drive real revenue impact.
 



 If you are a first\-principle thinker who is relentlessly curious, highly analytical, and communicates exceptionally well, this is the place to accelerate your career.
 



  





**What You Will Actually Do:** 



* **Market Intelligence \& GTM:** 
 Conduct deep\-dive research into new markets, HR tech trends, and competitor landscapes to identify white\-space opportunities for Joveo.
* **Process Optimization:** 
 Audit our existing supply and partnership workflows. Find the bottlenecks, propose data\-backed solutions, and help build the Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to fix them.
* **Data Storytelling:** 
 Analyze performance dashboards to find hidden patterns. You won't just pull data; you will translate it into actionable business insights for the leadership team.
* **Cross\-Functional Execution:** 
 Collaborate daily with global supply, product, and sales teams. You will need to influence stakeholders and manage moving parts to get projects across the finish line.
* **Pitch \& Asset Creation:** 
 Help draft strategic partnership decks, executive summaries, and internal memos that are sharp, persuasive, and clear.



  





**Who We Are Looking For:** 



* **You are "Smart" (Analytical):** 
 You don't just accept things as they are. You break problems down to their fundamental truths (first\-principle thinking) and build solutions from there.
* **You are a Great Communicator:** 
 You can take a complex, 10\-page concept and distill it into a punchy, 3\-bullet Slack message. You are comfortable speaking up in a room full of senior leaders.
* **High Agency:** 
 You don't wait to be told what to do. If you see a problem, you research it, propose a solution, and ask for permission to execute.
* **Tech Fluency:** 
 You are comfortable working with spreadsheets, presentation tools, and quickly learning new SaaS platforms. (Bonus points if you know your way around basic data visualization).



  





**What’s In It For You:** 



* **Direct Mentorship:** 
 Work directly under the Chief Strategic Initiatives Officer and learn how to scale businesses from $0 to multi\-million dollar ARR.
* **Real Impact:** 
 Your work will directly influence Joveo’s global expansion and bottom line.
* **Fast\-Tracked Learning:** 
 Get a crash course in B2B SaaS, Ad\-Tech, strategic partnerships, and global supply chains.

title: AI Implementation & Performance Focus Expert

title: Business Intelligence Engineer II
description:
**Description**
 At Amazon, our goal is to be earth’s most customer\-centric company and to create a safe environment for both our customers and our associates. To achieve that, we need exceptionally talented, bright, dynamic, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history. We are looking for a talented business analyst to join the Regulatory Intelligence, Safety \& Compliance \[RISC] Global Data \& Analytics \[GDA] team.
   

  

 This role will be a key member of the Analytics team, responsible for driving analysis and insights to help make meaningful business decisions. As a BIE, you will focus on improving the success within business functions by analyzing data, discovering and solving real world problems, building metrics and business cases to improve customer experience, and providing timely data support for escalations to mitigate risk. We are focused on your success and want to build future leaders within Amazon. A key component of the role is to identify process and system improvement opportunities by developing the right metrics, analyzing data, and partnering with internal teams. In addition, you will design and develop automated reporting solutions to enable stakeholders to manage the business and make effective decisions. Lastly, you will enable effective decision making by retrieving and aggregating data from multiple sources and compiling it into a digestible and actionable format.
   

  

 This role requires an individual with excellent statistical and analytical abilities, deep knowledge of business intelligence solutions and business acumen. The successful candidate will be a self\-starter comfortable with ambiguity, with strong attention to detail, an ability to work in a fast\-paced and ever\-changing environment, and driven by a desire to innovate in this space.

title: Growth Manager
description:
**BrandCrest Holdings** 
 is a diversified business group committed to building agile, high\-impact brands across India’s evolving business landscape. We operate through three key verticals:
 


* **AdCrest –** 
 Our ATL\-led integrated marketing agency, planning and owning large\-scale outdoor, transit, cinema, radio, and digital OOH campaigns, integrating BajuGali for BTL execution and TrendLabs for digital marketing.
* **FinCrest –** 
 Our niche CFO services firm for startups and SMEs, offering virtual CFO leadership, financial reporting, compliance, taxation, and business process automation.
* **DigitalSME –** 
 Our AI\-powered SaaS suite, building business automation and workflow software, including invoicing and payroll/HR tools, with more products on the way.



  





**About the Role:** 




 We're hiring a Growth Manager to own and scale user acquisition, activation, and revenue growth across DigitalSME's product portfolio. DigitalSME is BrandCrest's newest vertical, currently commercializing its invoicing and payroll/HR software, so this is a high\-ownership, hands\-on role for someone who has done this before in an early\-stage B2B SaaS environment — someone who can build a growth engine from the ground up, not just run campaigns inside an existing one. You will report directly to the founding team.
 



 You'll work closely with the founding team, product, and sales to turn DigitalSME's product suite into a predictable pipeline of qualified SME/professional\-services customers, across both live products and upcoming launches. In the first few months, the priority is building repeatable acquisition and activation for the live products, before scaling across the full portfolio.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Own the growth strategy and roadmap across acquisition, activation, retention, and expansion for DigitalSME's SaaS products.
* Build and manage multi\-channel demand generation — SEO, paid (search/social), content, email/lifecycle, partnerships, and outbound — with a clear eye on CAC and payback period.
* Define and instrument the growth funnel (awareness → demo → trial/signup → activation → paid → expansion), and own the metrics that matter: MQL/SQL conversion, CAC, LTV, activation rate, churn.
* Run structured, high\-velocity experimentation (A/B tests, landing pages, messaging, pricing/packaging) to find and scale what works.
* Partner with Product to improve onboarding and activation flows, using product\-led growth tactics where relevant.
* Work with Sales to ensure smooth handoff of qualified leads and tighten the marketing\-to\-sales loop.
* Build positioning and messaging for DigitalSME's live product lines (Invoice, Payroll \& HR), tailored to their specific buyer personas, and extend this to new lines (Advertising ERP, CA/Accounting ERP, Fraud Detection) as they launch.
* Set up and own growth reporting/dashboards; report results and learnings to leadership regularly.
* Manage growth budget and any external agencies/freelancers/tools.



  





**Specification:** 



* 2–3 years in a growth, performance marketing, or demand generation role, with a significant portion spent at a B2B SaaS company (early\-to\-growth stage strongly preferred).
* Proven track record of owning a growth funnel end\-to\-end and moving core metrics — CAC, activation, conversion, retention — with numbers to show for it.
* Strong hands\-on experience with paid acquisition, SEO, lifecycle/email marketing, and marketing/growth analytics tools (e.g., GA4, HubSpot/Zoho, Mixpanel/Amplitude, Meta/Google Ads).
* Comfortable with both strategy and execution — you're equally happy building a quarterly growth plan and personally shipping a landing page or campaign.
* Data\-driven and experiment\-led: you form hypotheses, test fast, and kill what doesn't work.
* Understanding of SME and professional\-services buyer behavior is a strong plus (agencies, accounting firms, consultancies).
* Excellent written communication — you'll be shaping positioning and messaging directly.
* Startup mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and building processes rather than inheriting them.



  





**Qualification:** 



* Experience growing a product from early stage to a defined GTM motion.
* Exposure to product\-led growth (PLG) models alongside sales\-assisted motions.
* Familiarity with vertical SaaS or workflow/operations software for SMEs.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work under tight deadlines.

* Mentorship

**Role Overview** 




 We're looking for a sharp, analytical marketer to own our inbound and performance marketing channels end\-to\-end. This isn't a "run the ads and report the numbers" role. You'll be the one diagnosing
 *why* 
 a metric moved, tracing it back through the funnel, and fixing it before it becomes a bigger problem.
 



 You'll work across website, SEO platforms, Google Search Ads and Meta Ads, constantly asking "why" at every drop\-off point in the funnel, and using AI tools to speed up how fast you can find and fix issues. You'll also partner with our design team to iterate on creative (headlines, ad copy, content) based on what the data tells you, and pick up the connected systems: CRM, ad platforms, analytics; quickly enough to see how a change in one shows up in another.
 



 Alongside this, you'll contribute to a growing area of the role: improving how often we're mentioned by AI/LLM tools (AU mention rate) and growing organic/inbound traffic \- identifying the right initiatives, building repeatable playbooks, and supporting SEO and content efforts.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Performance Channel Ownership:** 
 Run Google Search Ads and Meta Ads day\-to\-day, driving the funnel consistently against pipeline/lead targets.
* **Root Cause Analysis:** 
 For every dip or spike in a campaign metric, dig into
 *why* 
 it happened. Don't just report the number, explain and act on it.
* **AI\-Leveraged Optimization:** 
 Use AI tools to surface issues across campaigns faster (underperforming ad sets, budget leaks, audience fatigue, etc.) and fix them on an ongoing basis to maximize ROI.
* **Creative Problem\-Solving:** 
 Diagnose when creative (headlines, ad copy, landing content) is the bottleneck, brief the design team clearly, and see changes through to accurate implementation.
* **Systems Thinking:** 
 Understand how performance channels connect to the CRM and other tools in the stack, so you can trace a lead from ad click to conversion and troubleshoot across the whole chain, not just one platform.
* **LLM Visibility \& Organic Growth:** 
 Identify and prioritize initiatives that improve our visibility in AI/LLM\-driven search and recommendations; support efficiency playbooks and SEO/content efforts that grow organic traffic and conversions.



  





**Requirements** 



* **Experience:** 
 1\-2 years in a high\-pace environment: startups or similarly demanding settings / teams. Prior performance marketing experience is a plus but not mandatory if the problem\-solving chops are strong.
* **Education:** 
 Graduate from a top\-tier college; IIT/NIT strongly preferred.



  





**Core Qualities We're Looking For** 



* **Analytical Ability:** 
 You rely on data, not opinions, to make decisions.
* **Problem\-Solving:** 
 When a metric drops, you don't just report it \- you find out why and fix it.
* **First\-Principles Thinking:** 
 You figure things out from the basics instead of copying what worked elsewhere.
* **Fast Learner:** 
 You can pick up a new tool or platform on your own, without much guidance.
* **Systems Thinking:** 
 You understand how the CRM, ad platforms, and analytics connect, so you can trace an issue back to its source.



  





**Nice\-to\-Haves (Bonus Points)** 



* Prior exposure to SEO fundamentals or content strategy.
* Experience building or improving marketing playbooks/SOPs.
* Familiarity with LLM/AI\-search visibility as an emerging marketing lever.



  





**Soft Skills** 



* **Ownership:** 
 You treat the channels like they're your own budget. You will be required to coordinate with design/web/content teams, but the buck stops at you; you need to do whatever it takes to get the job done
* **Communicator:** 
 You can explain a technical or data\-driven decision to non\-marketing stakeholders in plain English.

title: Demand Generation and Growth Manager
description:
Enterprise Bot is the leading provider of GenAI, Conversational AI and automation software, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland.
 


  


 Our intelligent virtual assistants and automation tools help companies increase efficiency, reduce costs, and deliver exceptional customer experiences in industries such as banking, insurance, and logistics. Our mission is to become the world's leading provider of AI\-powered automation software within the next five years.
 


  


 We work with leading companies such as SIX Group (Swiss Stock Exchange), SWICA, Generali and others to improve customer interactions and automate business processes using our state\-of\-the\-art Conversational AI technology.
 


  


 Our global team comprises more than 70 highly qualified professionals from diverse backgrounds.
 


  


 We foster an open, progressive company culture with state\-of\-the\-art technology and flat hierarchies. At Enterprise Bot, you'll experience a unique blend of passion, ambition, challenge, and fun.
 


  

 Tasks
   


 Enterprise Bot builds agentic AI for voice, chat, email and messaging, and sells it to large enterprises in deals with long cycles, multiple stakeholders, procurement scrutiny and real compliance requirements.
 


  


 Our growth constraint is not awareness. It is qualified, sales\-ready pipeline in the accounts we actually want. This role owns that pipeline. You will design, run and optimise the programmes that generate and convert demand across Europe, and you will be measured on pipeline and revenue contribution rather than on lead volume.
 


  


**What you'll own:** 



  


**Pipeline generation** 



  

  
* Own the demand generation strategy and quarterly pipeline targets by region and segment
  
* Design and run integrated campaigns across paid search, paid social, content syndication, SEO, email and webinars
  
* Build and run account\-based marketing programmes against a defined target account list, in tight coordination with sales
  
* Develop the outbound support layer: sequences, content and intent\-based targeting that make SDR and AE outreach land
  


  


**Funnel ownership and conversion** 



  

  
* Own the funnel end to end, from traffic and conversion through MQL, SQL, opportunity and closed\-won, and diagnose where it leaks
  
* Build and maintain lead scoring, routing and nurture flows so that sales receives genuinely qualified handoffs
  
* Run structured experimentation on landing pages, offers, messaging and channel mix
  
* Improve conversion rates on existing traffic before spending to increase it
  


  


**Marketing operations and measurement** 



  

  
* Own the marketing automation and CRM stack (HubSpot), including workflows, lifecycle stages, data hygiene and attribution
  
* Build reporting that connects spend to pipeline to revenue, and report it honestly to leadership
  
* Manage the demand generation budget with clear accountability for cost per opportunity and pipeline ROI
  


  


**Website ownership** 



  

  
* You own the website as a platform and as a conversion asset. Product Marketing owns the messaging on
  
* core product and solution pages, and Content owns localisation into market languages.
  
* Own the website platform and CMS, including the publishing workflow, page templates, governance and release process
  
* Own technical SEO and site performance, including site structure, page speed, indexation, structured data and Core Web Vitals
  
* Own site analytics and tracking, including tag management, event tracking, consent management and the attribution model
  
* Build and optimise landing pages and campaign pages, and run continuous conversion rate optimisation across the site
  
* Implement the information architecture and site narrative proposed by Product Marketing, and challenge it where it conflicts with conversion or search performance
  
* Coordinate with Content on the rollout and technical implementation of localised pages, including hreflang and market\-level site structure
  
* Manage external web development or agency resource where required
  


  


**Programmes and partners** 



  

  
* Run the webinar and event programme, including field and industry events across Europe and India
  
* Build co\-marketing programmes with integrators, BPOs and technology partners
  
* Work with Product Marketing so that campaign messaging reflects current positioning rather than drifting from it
  
* Support product and platform launches with the demand side of the launch plan
  


  

 Requirements
   

  
* 5\+ years in demand generation, growth or performance marketing within B2B technology, SaaS or enterprise software
  
* Track record generating pipeline for enterprise deals with long, complex sales cycles, rather than SMB or self\-serve motions
  
* Hands\-on expertise with marketing automation and CRM, ideally HubSpot. You build the workflows yourself
  
* Hands\-on website ownership experience, including working directly in a CMS, and practical technical SEO capability rather than oversight of someone else doing it
  
* Working knowledge of web analytics and tag management implementation, including event tracking and consent requirements under GDPR
  
* Strong analytical capability across funnel diagnostics, attribution, and cohort and channel analysis
  
* Demonstrated ABM experience against named enterprise accounts
  
* Paid media management experience with real budget accountability
  
* Strong written English
  
* Comfort operating with European working hours for part of the day
  


  


**Strongly preferred** 



  

  
* Experience marketing to European enterprise buyers, particularly in financial services or insurance
  
* Background in conversational AI, CCaaS, contact centre or enterprise automation categories
  
* Experience running multilingual campaigns across European markets, and managing a multilingual website structure
  
* SQL or advanced analytics capability
  
* Experience in a company scaling from founder\-led sales toward a repeatable marketing engine
  


  


**How we’ll know you are the right fit** 



  

  
* You talk in pipeline and revenue, not impressions and MQLs
  
* You can point to specific programmes you built and the pipeline they produced
  
* You have killed a channel that was not working, and can explain how you knew
  


  


**First 90 days** 



  

  
* **Days 1 to 30:** 
 Full funnel audit complete. Baseline metrics established by channel and region. Website technical SEO and tracking audit complete, with gaps identified.
  
* **Days 31 to 60:** 
 Target account list agreed with sales. First ABM programme live. The two or three highest\-potential channels prioritised and resourced.
  
* **Days 61 to 90:** 
 Repeatable campaign cadence running. Pipeline reporting live and trusted by sales leadership. A clear view of cost per opportunity by channel.
  


  

 Benefits
   

  
* **Shape a function from the ground up** 
 – Build Enterprise Bot's first Product Marketing function and have a direct impact on product strategy, positioning and go\-to\-market.
  
* **Work with cutting\-edge AI** 
 – Help define the market narrative for an enterprise\-grade agentic AI platform used by leading financial services, insurance and public sector organisations across Europe.
  
* **Global exposure** 
 – Collaborate daily with Product, Engineering and commercial teams across Switzerland, Spain, Poland, the UK and other European markets.
  
* **High ownership, low bureaucracy** 
 – Take ownership of launches, competitive strategy and messaging, with the autonomy to influence business decisions and work directly with senior leadership.
  
* **Competitive salary and performance\-based incentives** 
 – We offer a competitive compensation package aligned to experience and impact.
  


  


 This is a unique opportunity to build a Growth Marketing function from the ground up and influence how Enterprise Bot competes and grows across Europe. If that excites you, we'd love to hear from you.

PhonePe\-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
   

  

**Job Description**
 About The Role
   

  

 We are looking for a Creative Strategist dedicated to Instagram Reels and short\-form video formats. Your goal is to capture immediate attention, drive organic reach, and build brand affinity through rapid, high\-impact creative concepts. You understand short\-form visual grammar, trend dynamics, audio triggers, and how to hold attention in a scroll\-heavy feed. You bridge the gap between creative storytelling and growth, giving our production team precise blueprints to execute.
   

  

 Focus Area 1: Short\-Form Concepting \& Trend Capture
   

  

* Rapid Trend Hunting: Monitor social feeds, audio trends, visual formats, and financial commentary to spot viral concepts as they emerge.
* Concept Architecture: Design high\-performing Reel formats, visual hooks, and text\-on\-screen structures tailored specifically for short attention spans.
* Hook Strategy: Craft the visual, textual, and audio hooks for the first 3 seconds of every short\-form piece to maximize view completion rates.
* Batch Strategy: Build repeatable content frameworks and series formats that can be produced at scale without losing creative quality.


 Focus Area 2: Visual Storytelling \& Messaging
   

  

* Script \& Beat Sheets: Write snappy, concise beat sheets and script outlines for creators, on\-camera talent, and video editors.
* Visual Direction: Specify text overlays, b\-roll references, graphics, and pacing notes so the editor knows exactly how the final output should feel.
* Performance Analysis: Review reach, saves, shares, and watch time metrics to constantly refine narrative hooks and visual execution.


**Qualifications**
 What We Are Looking For
   

  

* Short\-Form Mastery: Track record of concepting high\-reach Instagram Reels or short\-form video content that drives high engagement and shares.
* Visual Pacing Sense: Intuitive understanding of edit speed, visual triggers, text placement, and sound design for modern social feeds.
* Distillation Skills: Ability to take a complex financial or product concept and turn it into a simple 30 to 60\-second visual story.


 Mindset To Succeed
   

  

* Speed \& Velocity: You thrive on fast\-paced execution, moving from an idea on your phone to a creative brief in minutes.
* Audience First: You know what makes someone stop scrolling, save a post, or share a Reel with a friend.

**About The Role**
 Billing infrastructure is revenue infrastructure. In a business running an enterprise sales\-led motion and a product\-led self\-serve motion in parallel, the configuration quality of that stack directly determines what Finance can close cleanly, what customers are billed accurately, and how much revenue is recovered when payments fail. We’re hiring a systems administrator who treats it that way.
   

  

 We are seeking a Systems Administrator, Billing Systems to serve as the senior platform expert across our billing stack and a trusted operational partner to Finance, RevOps, and Product Engineering. This role will own day\-to\-day administration of and production support across the billing systems landscape in a scaled, dual\-motion SaaS environment.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Billing Systems Administration
   

  

* Own multiple billing platform administration for both our PLG self\-serve motion and enterprise\-grade invoicing and billing, including: payment methods, product and pricing catalog, subscription lifecycle, webhook monitoring, and dispute handling
* Maintain pricing configurations, billing templates, and subscription structures as directed by Finance and RevOps. When the price book changes, Billing Systems reflects it cleanly
* Own dunning and revenue recovery configuration: retry schedules, smart retry settings, grace period logic, and dunning email sequences. Monitor recovery rates and optimize the sequence over time
* Monitor platform health proactively. Identify processing failures, data integrity issues, and configuration gaps before they surface in Finance reporting or customer invoices
* Serve as the primary Stripe and BillingPlatform platform contact for Finance, RevOps, and the billing engineering team
* Execute configuration changes following change management controls: documented, tested, and deployed cleanly


 Quote\-to\-Cash Integrations
   

  

* Maintain the integration between Selling/Quoting systems and Billing Systems so quote\-to\-cash data flows are intact and deals land correctly in relevant billing systems
* Support CPQ\-related billing configurations in partnership with the CPQ Lead: price book alignment, quote output formats, and contract\-to\-subscription linkages
* Configure and test PLG self\-serve billing flows for new product launches, pricing changes, free trial conversion logic, and self\-serve subscription management


 Provisioning Connectivity
   

  

* Partner with Product Engineering on the billing\-to\-provisioning handoff across both PLG self\-serve and SLG enterprise motions.
* Maintain the billing\-side integration touchpoints that connect Stripe and BillingPlatform to provisioning workflows, ensuring subscription and order events carry the right data for downstream customer access
* Monitor the billing\-to\-provisioning handoff and escalate with context when subscription or order events fail to propagate cleanly into customer access
* Support provisioning impact assessment when pricing, packaging, or tier structures change on the billing side


 Data Quality \& Reconciliation
   

  

* Run regular data quality checks across billing systems: subscriber data, payment records, invoice history, and subscription states across SLG and PLG customers
* Support billing reconciliation across BillingPlatform, Stripe, Avalara, and NetSuite
* Support month\-end and quarter\-end close with clean, complete, defensible data for Finance reporting
* Maintain runbooks and escalation documentation for common billing data issues


**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience in billing systems administration, revenue operations, or SaaS billing in environments serving both enterprise and self\-serve customers
* Deep hands\-on experience with Stripe: subscription management, payment processing, webhook configuration, dunning configuration, and PLG billing flows
* Hands\-on experience with an enterprise subscription billing platform such as BillingPlatform, Revenue Cloud, Zuora, or Chargebee
* Development skills in building automation workflows in billing systems via API, webhooks, and other workflow configurations
* Familiarity with Salesforce CPQ: quote\-to\-cash process, price book structure, and integration touchpoints with billing systems
* Familiarity with billing\-to\-provisioning integration patterns and partnership with product engineering teams on subscription event propagation
* Experience supporting billing reconciliation with Finance through NetSuite or equivalent ERP
* Experience in B2B SaaS environments with both sales\-led and product\-led revenue motions


**Preferred**

**Job Description:**
--------------------

  

* Senior Technical Editor AI Software Architecture and Enterprise Technology
* Infosys Knowledge Institute IKI is the thought leadership and research arm of Infosys
* It develops original evidence based perspectives that help business and technology leaders understand emerging trends make informed decisions and translate technology developments into enterprise value
* Through the Infosys Technology Review and other IKI publications we publish applied research deep technology perspectives enterprise architecture papers technology playbooks and executive strategy articles
* Our work combines the expertise of Infosys practitioners and technology leaders with rigorous research strong editorial judgment and clear implications for enterprises
* About the role
* We are looking for an accomplished Senior Technical Editor to strengthen the quality credibility and executive relevance of its technology thought leadership
* This is a substantive editorial role that extends well beyond copyediting
* The editor will critically assess whether a manuscript presents an original and defensible point of view whether its technical claims architecture and supporting evidence are sound and whether the argument is relevant and accessible to senior enterprise decision makers
* The editor will work across topics such as artificial intelligence generative and agentic AI software and enterprise architecture cloud data engineering cybersecurity digital platforms engineering practices and emerging technologies
* Publications may include
* Research and applied innovation papers
* Frontier technology and architecture perspectives
* Tech Navigator reports and implementation playbooks
* Executive technology strategy articles
* Multi article series and thematic research programs
* Working closely with authors subject matter experts IKI producers researchers designers and publishing teams the editor will serve as a critical editorial quality gate from manuscript development through final publication

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

  

* Provide substantive and developmental editing
* Evaluate the central thesis originality relevance and strength of each manuscript
* Determine whether the article addresses a meaningful enterprise problem and delivers a clear differentiated point of view
* Assess the logical progression of the argument and restructure manuscripts where required to improve coherence clarity and impact
* Identify unsupported assertions reasoning gaps contradictions excessive generalization and conclusions that extend beyond the available evidence
* Challenge manuscripts that merely describe a technology and help authors develop a stronger perspective on what it means for enterprises
* Ensure that introductions establish the problem and purpose clearly sections advance the argument and conclusions translate the analysis into meaningful implications or actions
* Preserve the author s expertise and voice while raising the manuscript to IKI s publication standards

  

**Technical Requirements:**

 Zylu is a fast\-growing SaaS startup helping salons and beauty businesses simplify appointments, customer engagement, marketing, and business operations through technology.
 



 With a growing presence across India and expanding traction in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Southeast Asia, we're building the operating system for the beauty and wellness industry.

 3 to 6 Years

 We are looking for a hands\-on growth marketing manager who has experience contributing to the growth of a SaaS company from approximately
 **$100K ARR to $3M ARR** 
 .
 



 You will own the growth funnel across customer acquisition, activation, retention, and expansion while working directly with leadership to build scalable growth systems.
 



 This role is ideal for someone who combines strategy with execution and is comfortable working across multiple growth channels.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 




  




* Own and drive growth across the entire customer journey from lead generation to retention and expansion.
* Build and optimise conversion funnels across website visitors, leads, demos, trials, and customers.

* Scale customer acquisition through channels such as SEO, content, paid marketing, partnerships, referrals, webinars, and communities.
* Work closely with Product, Sales, and Customer Success teams to improve activation and retention metrics.

* Build dashboards and reports to measure marketing performance and growth initiatives.

* Collaborate with founders and leadership on go\-to\-market strategy and expansion plans.

 **$100K ARR to $3M\-$5M ARR**

title: Post Doc Researcher
description:
**Overview**
 The Future of Scalable Software Engineering (FoSSE) team in CoreAI, Microsoft, invites applications for postdoctoral researcher positions. FoSSE is an applied research team focused on solving real\-world software engineering (SE) problems for large codebases, including code migration, code translation, and static analysis, using AI and formal methods. Our postdoc program provides an opportunity to work on practical research problems while collaborating closely with Microsoft researchers and product groups. Postdocs spend 1\-2 years with us and receive ongoing guidance and mentoring from experienced colleagues. We work at the intersection of programming language design, formal methods, static analysis, and AI.
   

  

 Applicants should have a strong background in one or both of the following tracks:
   

  

**PL track:** 
 Strong background in programming languages, compilers, or related areas, and an interest in combining AI with these techniques to solve SE problems at scale and with high quality.
   

  

**Reinforcement Learning (RL) track:** 
 Strong background in LLM post\-training (e.g., RLHF, instruction tuning, alignment, evaluation) and an interest in applying these techniques to SE.
   

  

**Application Procedure**
 Apply with your CV and at least two letters of recommendation. The letters must be submitted directly by the letter writers via email to fosse\-hiring@microsoft.com.After submitting your application, you may also email your CV to fosse\-hiring@microsoft.com.Applications will be considered on an ongoing basis. For any queries, please write to fosse\-hiring@microsoft.com.
   

  

 The positions are based in Bangalore, where we are co\-located with Microsoft Research India. FoSSE provides an excellent research environment and a welcoming, diverse community. The team includes full\-time researchers and engineers, along with postdocs, interns, and research fellows in fixed\-term roles. Learn more about Microsoft’s commitment to Global Diversity and Inclusion here.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Working with FoSSE and other Microsoft colleagues on applied research problems at the intersection of PL, SE, and AI.
* Experimenting with and building tools that work on real world and large code bases.

description:
Who Are We?
   

  

 RZR is an AI\-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full\-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose\-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.
   

  

 We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.
   

  

 RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M\&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 As Creative Strategist at RZR, you will translate audience insights, performance data, and campaign objectives into actionable content strategies and creative concepts that drive measurable results across mobile advertising platforms.
   

  

 This role sits within the Creative Growth pod as an individual contributor — owning research, audience analysis, creative hypotheses, and copy development for assigned accounts. You will work closely with the Creative Strategy Manager, Creative Designers, and Analytics to ensure strategic intent flows through from brief to final execution.
   

  

 This is not a generalist content or social media role. This is a performance\-focused, insight\-driven strategy role in a mobile advertising environment.
   

  

 The right person for this role is analytically curious and creatively sharp — someone who can read a performance signal, build a hypothesis around it, write the copy to test it, and document what they learned. You will operate with real ownership across your accounts from day one.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Conduct independent market, competitive, and audience research for assigned accounts
* Develop content strategies aligned to campaign goals and client KPIs
* Tailor creative concepts to specific audience segments using behavioural and psychographic data
* Generate new creative concepts based on performance insights and research findings
* Write and develop copy for ad creatives — headlines, CTAs, and messaging frameworks
* Synthesise performance signals into actionable hypotheses for creative testing
* Identify A/B testing opportunities from campaign data and propose structured test frameworks
* Maintain audience profiles, user personas, and competitor insight documents
* Support QBR preparation with research, insights, and audience\-specific recommendations
* Monitor performance reports and flag emerging trends or declining signals
* Document all hypotheses, test results, and learnings in the shared knowledge base
* Coordinate with Creative Designers on concept visualisation and storyboarding
* Interface with Analytics for performance data pulls and reporting inputs


**Required Skills And Experience**
 Must\-Have
   

  

* 3–5 years of experience in content strategy, creative strategy, or a performance creative role in a digital or mobile advertising environment
* Demonstrated ability to develop content strategies and creative concepts grounded in audience data and performance insights
* Strong copywriting skills — able to craft compelling ad headlines, CTAs, and messaging frameworks
* Familiarity with mobile advertising platforms and performance metrics (CTR, IPM, ROAS, CPI)
* Experience synthesising research and data into clear, actionable recommendations
* Ability to manage multiple accounts and workstreams simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong attention to detail and a high standard for output quality
* Collaborative working style with clear, structured communication


 Nice\-to\-Have
   

  

* Exposure to creative A/B testing frameworks and hypothesis\-led thinking
* Familiarity with platform\-specific creative best practices (Meta, TikTok, Google UAC, DSPs)
* Experience in ad tech, programmatic, or mobile\-first marketing environments
* Experience contributing to QBR preparation or client\-facing strategy documentation


 Work Setup
   

  

 This is a hybrid role requiring regular onsite attendance for collaboration, creative reviews, and team activities. Creative team members may occasionally work onsite more frequently depending on project demands. Fully remote candidates will not be considered.
   

  

 Why Join RZR in Manila / Bangalore?
   

  

* Embedded strategy with direct influence on performance — you are not producing content in a vacuum. Your hypotheses get tested, your copy runs in live campaigns, and you see the results. The feedback loop is real and fast.
* Work across a diverse portfolio of mobile advertising accounts — no two accounts are the same. You will build genuine depth across different verticals, audiences, and creative formats.
* Close collaboration with Creative Leadership and cross\-functional partners — you will work directly alongside the Creative Strategy Manager and interface regularly with Analytics and Revenue. Your work is seen and valued.
* High\-ownership environment — your ideas matter here. If you have a hypothesis, you can propose it, test it, and own the outcome.
* Clear progression path — the natural next step from this role is Senior Creative Strategist, with a well\-defined track within the Creative Growth pod.


 RZR Behaviors
   

  

 RZR operates by eight core behaviors: Extreme Ownership
   

  

* Move Fast
* Drive for Excellence
* Proactive Communication
* Courage
* Curiosity
* Deliver Results
* Manage Ambiguity

This is an internal role at Weekday. Not a role by a client.
   

  

  

* Role type: Full time
* Location: Remote
* Working with: CEO and Cofounder


 Weekday is an AI\-native recruiting platform. We are backed by Y Combinator and Venture Highway (now General Catalyst). We have built the largest white collar talent database in India and have built tools to run outbound recruiting campaigns to them.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a growth role, not a strategy role. You will sit next to the CEO and own one number: revenue growth for one of our core product lines. Everything you do — every piece of content, every cold email, every demo call — either moves that number or it doesn't.
   

  

 You won't be handed a playbook, a team, or a warmed\-up pipeline. You'll build the GTM engine yourself: figure out which channels work, build them, and scale the ones that do. Some weeks that means writing content and tuning SEO/AEO so buyers find us. Other weeks it means running demo calls back\-to\-back and following up aggressively until deals close. If you think of yourself as either "a marketer" or "a salesperson" but not both, this isn't for you.
   

  

 What you'll actually do
   

  

 On any given day you might be:
   

  

  

* Running the full inside\-sales motion — taking demo calls, handling objections, following up relentlessly, and closing
* Building content that actually converts: landing pages, comparison pages, blog posts, and material designed to rank on search and get picked up by AI answer engines (AEO)
* Setting up and running outbound systems — cold email, cold calls, LinkedIn, or whatever channel gets us in front of the right buyers
* Writing scripts and light automations to scale yourself — scraping lead lists, wiring up email sequences, building dashboards so you know what's working
* Testing a new growth channel, killing it fast if it doesn't work, and doubling down if it does
* Reporting your numbers honestly to the founders, including the ugly ones


 You'll be measured on revenue — pipeline created and deals closed. Not on activity, not on slides.
   

  

 What we're looking for
   

  

  

* You can sell. You're sharp on calls, you can run a demo that lands, and you follow up like the deal depends on it — because it does
* You know your way around code and tech. You can write a script, wire up an API, or build your own tooling instead of waiting for an engineer
* You've done growth before — content, SEO, cold email, cold calling, or any sales system you built and ran yourself — and you can show what it produced
* You take ownership. When the number is yours, it moves — no follow\-ups needed
* You work hard and sweat the details. Conscientiousness isn't optional here; the follow\-up you skip is the deal you lose
* You're comfortable with ambiguity. No playbook, no hand\-holding, no fully\-defined role. The role is what you make it


 What you get

description:
**Associate – Front Office** 




 Loop by Zolo
 



**Be the first smile. Be the calm in the chaos. Be the reason guests return.** 




  





**Company Name:** 
 ZoloStays
 



**Business Unit:** 
 Loop by Zolo
 



**Designation:** 
 Front Office Associate
 



**CTC Offered:** 
 3\.63 LPA (30,000 inhand)
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




 At Loop by Zolo, the front office is not just a function — it is the first and last impression of the brand. Every guest interaction, from pre\-arrival to checkout, shapes how the hotel is perceived and whether the guest returns or recommends us.
 



 While product and infrastructure create the base, it is the front office that brings the experience to life.
 



 This role exists to ensure that every guest interaction is handled with clarity, warmth, and discipline — resulting in seamless stays and consistent 5\-star ratings.
 



 If the Front Office is strong, guests feel welcomed, supported, and delighted. If the Front Office is weak, even a good product feels broken.
 



  





**Your mandate is clear** 



* Own the guest journey end\-to\-end — from pre\-arrival to checkout
* Deliver smooth, fast, and warm check\-in and check\-out experiences
* Handle all guest interactions with clarity and professionalism
* Ensure all service requests and issues are resolved quickly
* Drive 5\-star reviews through consistent guest engagement
* Represent the brand with energy and hospitality



 This is not a desk role. It is active ownership of guest experience and satisfaction.
 



  





**About Zolo** 




 Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.
 



 People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.
 



 Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.
 



 Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living.
 



 Z Vacations enables meaningful travel experiences.
 



 Z Hotels serves the modern traveler with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.
 



 Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life.
 



 Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new generation by partnering deeply with property owners who think long term.
 



 Loop by Zolo is designed for the new\-age traveler seeking vibrant, social, and dependable stays.
 



 We combine hospitality, comfort, and community to create experiences that feel welcoming, energetic, and effortless.
 



 Backed by Zolo’s operational expertise and hospitality standards, Loop focuses on creating spaces where guests feel connected, comfortable, and cared for.
 



 As we scale across locations, guest experience consistency becomes critical — and the front office team plays the biggest role in making that happen.
 



  





**What you will be responsible for** 




 1\. Manage Pre\-Arrival Guest Experience
 


* Call guests before arrival to confirm booking and expectations
* Provide clear directions, check\-in details, and support
* Set the tone for a smooth arrival experience



 2\. Deliver Seamless Check\-in \& Check\-out
 


* Ensure fast, smooth, and error\-free check\-in
* Welcome guests with warmth and professionalism
* Handle check\-out efficiently with proper closure
* Ensure no delays or confusion for guests



 3\. Handle Guest Interaction \& Service Requests
 


* Be the primary point of contact for all guest queries
* Respond promptly and politely to all requests
* Coordinate with housekeeping and other teams for service delivery
* Ensure every request is closed properly



 4\. Manage Guest Complaints \& Escalations
 


* Handle guest concerns calmly and professionally
* Take ownership of issues and drive resolution
* Escalate when required and follow through till closure
* Ensure guest leaves satisfied



 5\. Drive Guest Engagement \& Reviews
 


* Proactively interact with guests during their stay
* Identify happy guests and encourage 5\-star reviews
* Ensure guest feedback is captured and acted upon
* Build a positive and memorable experience



 6\. Ensure Process Discipline \& Accuracy
 


* Follow all front office SOPs consistently
* Maintain accuracy in guest details and records
* Ensure coordination across teams is smooth
* Adhere to daily routines and checklists



  





**What success looks like after 6–12 months** 



* Consistently high guest ratings (4\.7\+ / 5\-star focus)
* Smooth and fast check\-in/check\-out experience
* Positive guest feedback on staff behavior and support
* No missed service requests or unresolved complaints
* Strong contribution to hotel reputation and repeat guests



 The front office feels warm, efficient, and consistently reliable.
 



  





**Who this role is for** 




 You will likely thrive here if:
 


* You enjoy interacting with people and making them comfortable
* You take ownership of guest experience end\-to\-end
* You communicate clearly and confidently
* You are disciplined and do not miss processes
* You remain calm and professional under pressure
* You want to build a career in hospitality operations



  





**Experience we value** 



* Fresh graduates from hospitality institutes (preferred)
* Freshers from other backgrounds with strong communication
* 0–1 year experience in front office / guest handling roles (optional)
* Comfortable speaking in English \+ local language
* Basic comfort with systems and coordination



 Hospitality background is preferred but not mandatory. Communication, ownership, and discipline are critical.
 



  





**The impact you will have** 



* You directly shape guest experience and satisfaction
* You influence hotel ratings and online reputation
* You are the face of the brand for every guest
* You impact repeat business and referrals



  





**Why join now** 




 Loop by Zolo is scaling rapidly with a focus on consistent, high\-quality guest experience. Front office excellence will be a key differentiator in this journey.
 



 This role is the foundation for growth into larger hotel operations and leadership roles.
 



 If you believe in delivering great service with discipline and ownership — this is the right role.

**Technical Skills** 




  




* Enterprise hands\-on model design covering demand, workload, productivity, shrinkage, service levels, location, and skill mix
* Advanced forecasting and quantitative methods: time\-series, regression, causal drivers, seasonality,
* Multi\-horizon demand and capacity planning across portfolios; workforce strategy

**Behavioral Skills**

**Job Overview** 




  





 The Workforce Management Associate Director will set the workforce planning strategy, governance, and operating model across multiple businesses, sites, or geographies. This player\-coach role combines senior stakeholder leadership with hands\-on expertise in WFM models, forecasting, demand and capacity planning, advanced Excel, and quantitative techniques. The incumbent will establish a single planning methodology, challenge investment and hiring assumptions, and ensure workforce decisions are aligned to service, cost, growth, and transformation priorities.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities** 




  




* Define and own the enterprise WFM strategy, methodology, governance, data standards, model controls, and planning calendar across multiple businesses or sites
* Personally review and, where required, build critical forecasting, demand, and capacity models; challenge assumptions, methodologies, forecast bias, and investment cases
* Integrate long\-range business outlook, budgets, transformation roadmaps, automation, location strategy, attrition, hiring, learning curves, and productivity into workforce scenarios
* Chair executive capacity reviews and present clear choices, risks, costs, and service implications to enable hiring, location, skill, vendor, and productivity decisions
* Establish performance measures for forecast accuracy, utilization, occupancy, shrinkage, capacity adherence, productivity, and plan benefits; drive corrective action across owners
* Lead and develop the WFM organization, strengthen quantitative and Excel capability, and partner with Finance, HR, Operations, and Technology to mature tools and planning automation



  





**Other Role Details** 



* Enterprise WFM Strategy
* Forecasting \& Capacity Governance
* Executive Decision Support

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**
**Blue Dart Express Limited** 
 , a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.
   

  

 Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.

 **Employer of Choice** 
 is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
   

  

 If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety,
 **Blue Dart is where you belong** 
 . Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
   

  

**Position Overview:**
 The
 **Ops Staff** 
 is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.
   

  

 The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.
   

  

**Job Purpose:**
 To support efficient shipment processing and operational activities by ensuring accurate handling, sorting, scanning and movement of shipments while maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, quality and compliance with Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* Perform shipment scanning, bagging, tagging and labelling activities in accordance with operational requirements.
* Support loading and unloading of shipments from vehicles while ensuring safe handling practices.
* Ensure timely movement of shipments through various operational stages to meet defined service commitments.
* Assist in shipment reconciliation and manifest verification activities.


**Data Entry \& Operational Documentation**
* Perform basic data entry and shipment updates using approved operational systems.
* Ensure accurate recording of shipment information and operational transactions.
* Verify shipment labels, manifests and operational documentation.
* Report shipment discrepancies or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain accuracy in operational records and documentation.


**Operational Support**

* Support peak volume operations and contingency requirements.
* Ensure operational workstations remain organised and ready for processing activities.
* Perform additional operational tasks as assigned by the reporting manager.


**Safety, Security \& Compliance**
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) while performing operational activities.
* Adhere to Blue Dart's safety, security and quality standards at all times.
* Handle customer shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Report unsafe conditions, operational incidents or security concerns immediately.
* Ensure proper usage of personal protective equipment (PPE) wherever applicable.


**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.


**Teamwork \& Continuous Improvement**
* Work collaboratively with colleagues across operational teams.
* Participate in operational briefings, safety meetings and training programmes.
* Share ideas for improving operational efficiency and workplace safety.
* Support implementation of new operational processes and initiatives.
* Contribute towards maintaining a positive and productive work environment.

description:
Sales is starting to lose deals to competitors nobody has properly studied, and the founders are tired of learning about a competitor's new pricing tier from a customer rather than their own team. A high\-growth, VC\-backed SaaS company hiring its founding India team wants this Competitive Intelligence Analyst to close that gap, and Flexiple has partnered with the company to make the hire.
 



 You would own the full loop: tracking competitor product and pricing moves, running win or loss debriefs with sales reps, and turning both into battlecards the sales team actually opens before a call. Early on this is a solo function: you decide what gets tracked and how.
 



 What we are looking for:
 


* 3 to 7 years in competitive intelligence, product marketing or sales enablement, ideally at a SaaS company
* Comfort running structured win or loss interviews and turning them into a clear narrative
* Experience building battlecards or teardown decks that a sales team has actually used
* Strong written communication and the judgment to prioritise what is worth tracking
* A bias toward shipping something useful this week over a perfect deck next quarter



 This is a remote\-friendly role for candidates based in Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad or Pune, or Remote (India). Expect an HR screening, a case\-style assignment and a panel conversation with the founders before an offer. Your profile stays active for this role and any future Flexiple\-matched opening once you apply here. To apply, submit your profile through this listing.

Our Offensive Security professionals are on a mission to make the world a safer place, one company at a time. Our clients trust us to use cutting\-edge offensive security tools, creativity, imagination, and expert knowledge to find cybersecurity risks in their networks, systems, and software.

You will also draft reports based on the assessment results and gathered evidence and help address client inquiries regarding these results. In addition to the execution of traditional security assessments, you will participate in their refinement and improvement.
   

  

 Below are the roles and responsibilities for the Associate Consultant, Offensive Security role based in Bangalore, India:

* Execute offensive security and consultative engagements for our clients’ applications, cloud assets, and infrastructure
* Author deliverables such as vulnerability reports and executive reports
* Engage with our clients to understand their requirements, update them on project status, answer their queries, and present your findings and recommendations
* Keep your skills and knowledge up to date with the latest trends in cybersecurity and emerging technology
* Willingness to work in EST Time zone as required


**Essential Traits**
* 1\+ years in cybersecurity, with at least 6 months in penetration testing, cloud security, or red teaming
* A strong understanding of offensive security methodology and vulnerability frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10, MITRE ATT\&CK, PTES, or others
* An ability to analyze root causes and deliver technological recommendations to our clients


**Prerequisites**
* Bachelor’s degree or college diploma in information security, computer science or engineering, software engineering, or IT/System/Network administration
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Experience working both as part of a team and independently

title: TL-Enrollment & Billing
description:
**Job Summary**
 This role focuses on managing complex enrollment and billing activities within a commercial insurance environment using Facets membership capabilities ensuring accurate member data timely billing cycles and high operational reliability. The professional will work from office in a night shift model driving quality outcomes process improvements and consistent service for clients and members while collaborating closely with cross functional partners.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage end to end enrollment and billing operations in a commercial insurance environment ensuring accurate member creation maintenance and termination activities aligned with client policies and regulatory standards.
* Coordinate daily Facets membership processing tasks including new enrollments updates reinstatements and coverage changes to maintain reliable eligibility records and downstream billing accuracy.
* Monitor billing cycles premium calculations and invoice generation activities to identify discrepancies early and drive timely resolution thereby supporting predictable revenue recognition for the organization.
* Analyze complex enrollment and billing issues in Facets membership and commercial insurance enrollments diagnose root causes and recommend practical remediation steps that prevent recurrence and support operational stability.
* Collaborate with operations finance and configuration teams to clarify benefit structures group setups and product rules so that enrollment data and billing outputs remain aligned with contractual commitments and client expectations.
* Develop and update standard operating procedures for enrollment and billing processes ensuring documentation reflects current commercial insurance practices Facets membership configurations and control checkpoints.
* Perform regular quality checks and reconciliation of member records billing files and payment postings to detect gaps between source data and system outputs driving corrective actions that protect data integrity and customer trust.
* Provide detailed status reporting on nightly batch runs production issues and backlog items in enrollment and billing enabling stakeholders to make informed decisions about priorities and resource allocation.
* Support incident and defect management by validating reported problems in Facets membership and enrollment workflows preparing clear analysis notes and partnering with technical teams for timely fixes.
* Guide process optimization efforts that streamline enrollment intake mapping and validation steps reducing manual touch points and improving turnaround time for commercial groups and individual members.
* Coordinate user acceptance validation for changes impacting enrollment and billing rules crafting realistic test scenarios based on commercial insurance use cases to confirm that system updates work as intended.
* Engage with internal clients and business partners to understand upcoming plan changes group additions and billing requirements translating those needs into precise enrollment processing tasks and timelines.
* Uphold compliance with relevant commercial insurance regulations and internal audit controls across all enrollment and billing operations ensuring documentation and system evidence are maintained for review.


**Qualifications**
* Possess strong applied experience in Facets membership functions including configuration awareness enrollment transactions and eligibility data management in a commercial insurance setting.
* Demonstrate deep practical knowledge of commercial insurance enrollment processes such as group and member setup coverage tier changes qualifying events and related billing dependencies.
* Apply solid understanding of medical insurance billing concepts including premium calculation logic invoice cycles grace periods and reconciliation practices to support accurate financial outcomes.
* Use analytical abilities and attention to detail to interpret enrollment source files identify data issues and design validation checks that improve overall data quality for downstream systems.
* Bring experience working in structured operations environments with night shift schedules maintaining productivity adherence to timelines and consistent coordination with cross site partners.
* Exhibit capability to document procedures create clear operational notes and communicate complexities in enrollment and billing processes to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.


**Certifications Required**
 Preferred certifications include health insurance specialist certification or professional training in Facets administration or payer operations.

**Job Description**
 We are looking for a Technical Consultant with an HR background and strong ABAP development experience to support HR\-related SAP solutions within a digital transformation environment. The role involves developing, enhancing, and supporting SAP HR/HCM solutions, working closely with HR stakeholders, and translating business requirements into technical specifications and developments.

**Qualifications**
* Proven experience as an SAP Technical Consultant with strong ABAP development skills.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP HR / HCM modules and HR business processes.
* Experience developing HR reports, interfaces, enhancements, forms, and workflows.
* Knowledge of HR processes such as employee lifecycle, payroll, time management, and organizational management.
* Experience with SAP debugging, performance tuning, and technical troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with SAP integration technologies and data migration tools is an advantage.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.


**Additional Information**
**WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN FUSION:**
 At Fusion, you’ll join a diverse team of talented professionals from around the world, united by a passion for delivering impactful digital transformation in the life sciences industry. You’ll be part of a flat\-structured, collaborative organization where decisions are made efficiently, and your expertise directly shapes client outcomes.
   

  

 You’ll work alongside experienced consultants on complex, meaningful projects that demand both precision and innovation. Our culture emphasizes continuous learning, open knowledge sharing, and cross\-functional teamwork—empowering you to grow both professionally and personally.

* Builds strong, trusted partnerships with clients, delivering tailored solutions that create real business value.
* Drives delivery excellence, holding ourselves accountable for the quality and impact of every outcome.
* Encourages entrepreneurial thinking, empowering you to take initiative, solve problems, and lead change.
* Operates with a truly global mindset, where diverse perspectives, cultures, and collaboration fuel our success.


**What We Offer \- Fusion Benefits**
 We’ve designed our benefits to support your growth, well\-being, and global mobility.
   

  

**Growth \& Development**
* Invest in Your Learning: Access annual training budget for professional development.
* Grow Your Skills: Join regular workshops and trainings to strengthen technical and soft skills.
* Advance Continuously: Build the mindset, confidence, and capabilities to grow your career on your terms.
* Shape an Inclusive Culture: Thrive in a workplace where your individuality is valued, and your voice drives meaningful change.


**Recognition \& Reward**
* Earn What You’re Worth: Receive a competitive salary and benefits package that reflects your impact.
* Refer Talent: Get rewarded for recommending new hires through our referral program.


**Global Mobility \& Local Support**
* Navigate Global Moves: Get help with visas, permits, and international assignments.
* Benefit Locally: Enjoy perks tailored to your country of residence.
* Collaborate Globally: Work in a diverse, inclusive culture where global teamwork drives success.


**Our Selection Process**
 Your time is valuable. That’s why our hiring process is clear, efficient, and focused on mutual fit:
   

  

**Upload Your CV**

**Wait for Profile Review**

**Join an Introductory Call**

**Attend a Technical Interview**
