**Identity \& Access Management (IAM) Administrator** 




**Position Summary** 




 The Identity \& Access Management (IAM) Administrator is responsible for supporting identity governance, access administration, privileged access management, cloud identity management, mobile device management, and IT asset management functions. This role assists in maintaining secure access controls, supporting compliance initiatives, managing user identities and entitlements, administering privileged accounts, and ensuring the integrity of access management processes across enterprise and cloud environments. The position works closely with Information Security, Infrastructure, Application Support, and Business teams to support secure and efficient access to organizational resources.
 



  





**Essential Job Functions** 




**Identity \& Access Management (IAM)** 



* Assist in managing AWS IAM users, groups, roles, and policies.
* Support role\-based access control (RBAC) implementation and maintenance for AWS services, including EC2, Lambda, and other cloud resources.
* Provision, modify, and deprovision user access across enterprise applications, cloud platforms, and infrastructure systems.
* Troubleshoot and resolve access\-related issues, including permission errors, authentication failures, and role assumption problems.
* Participate in periodic user access reviews, certification campaigns, and entitlement audits.
* Identify, document, and escalate inappropriate access, policy violations, and segregation of duties concerns.
* Maintain accurate identity data, including user attributes, roles, group memberships, and entitlements across supported systems.
* Audit and maintain access controls to ensure compliance with organizational security policies, standards, and regulatory requirements.



**Privileged Access Management (CyberArk)** 



* Assist in the administration and maintenance of CyberArk Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions.
* Support onboarding and management of privileged accounts, service accounts, and application accounts within CyberArk.
* Assist with account discovery, password vaulting, credential rotation, and privileged session management activities.
* Monitor CyberArk platform health, password management processes, and scheduled jobs to ensure operational effectiveness.
* Troubleshoot and resolve CyberArk\-related issues, including account onboarding failures, password reconciliation issues, and access request problems.
* Support privileged access request workflows, approvals, and access certifications in accordance with security policies.
* Assist in implementing and maintaining least\-privilege and privileged access security controls.
* Perform periodic reviews of privileged accounts and privileged access assignments to ensure compliance with organizational standards.
* Generate and maintain CyberArk reports related to privileged account activity, password management, and compliance requirements.
* Maintain CyberArk operational documentation, procedures, and onboarding standards.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, security, and application teams to onboard systems and accounts into CyberArk.



**Security \& Compliance** 



* Assist in implementing and maintaining security controls related to identity and access management.
* Support vulnerability remediation efforts by deploying updates, patches, and corrective actions in response to identified security risks.
* Assist with audit requests and provide supporting documentation related to access management, privileged access management, and asset inventories.
* Ensure adherence to established security policies, procedures, standards, and best practices.
* Support compliance initiatives related to access governance, privileged access management, and information security controls.

title: Talent Partner – Host Community & Engagement
description:
About Goodera
 



 Goodera is the world’s leading employee volunteering platform, powering companies to scale employee volunteering experiences globally through our innovative technology platform and unique operating model. With a presence in over 100 countries and support for 30\+ languages, we connect over 500 clients, including 60\+ Fortune 500 companies, with meaningful volunteer opportunities tailored to their communities. To date, our impact has reached over 10 million beneficiaries, powered by 1 million\+ employee volunteers and a network of 50,000\+ nonprofit partners. Growing at 100% year on year, we are backed by top investors including Zoom Ventures, Elevation Capital, Nexus Venture Partners, Omidyar Network, and Ursula Burns.
 



 As we expand our portfolio of large\-scale volunteering events, employee engagement activations, and flagship client experiences, we're looking for an experienced Event Production Manager to own execution of our most strategic events across the United States.
 



  





 About the Role
 



 We're looking for a Talent Partner to help build and scale Goodera's global host community.
 



  





 In this role, you'll own the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle for our host network—from sourcing and interviewing to onboarding and ensuring hosts are event\-ready. You'll work closely with the Host Community team to understand regional hiring needs, build talent pipelines, and ensure we always have the right hosts available to support our growing global operations.
 



  





 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys high\-volume hiring, building relationships, improving hiring processes, and working in a fast\-paced, global environment.
 



  





**Timings: 6 PM \- 3 AM** 




  





 What You'll Do
 



  





 End\-to\-End Recruitment
 


* Own the complete recruitment lifecycle for assigned geographies.
* Source candidates through multiple channels, including LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, and community outreach.
* Screen candidates to assess communication skills, professionalism, and role fit.
* Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and ensure a seamless candidate experience.
* Drive hiring against monthly and quarterly hiring targets.



  





 Host Onboarding
 


* Coordinate onboarding activities for newly hired hosts.
* Ensure documentation, contracts, and profile creation are completed accurately.
* Partner with the Host Community team to ensure every new hire is event\-ready within defined SLAs.
* Track onboarding progress and proactively resolve bottlenecks.



  





 Talent Pipeline Management
 


* Build and maintain talent pools across multiple geographies.
* Forecast hiring needs with business stakeholders.
* Maintain an active pipeline for priority markets.
* Re\-engage strong candidates for future hiring needs.



  





 Hiring Operations
 


* Maintain accurate recruitment data and reporting.
* Track hiring funnel metrics, conversion rates, and time\-to\-hire.
* Continuously improve recruitment processes and candidate experience.
* Partner with stakeholders to improve hiring efficiency and quality.



  





 Employer Branding
 


* Represent Goodera professionally throughout the hiring process.
* Deliver an outstanding candidate experience from first interaction through onboarding.
* Help strengthen Goodera's employer brand across global talent markets.



  





 What We're Looking For
 


* 2–5 years of experience in Talent Management/ Account Management/ Expert Network
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong sourcing skills using LinkedIn and other recruitment platforms.
* Ability to manage multiple hiring pipelines simultaneously.
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
* Comfortable working with hiring metrics and recruitment dashboards.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.
* Experience recruiting for global teams or international markets will be a strong advantage.



  





 Success in This Role
 



 Within your first six months, you will:
 


* Consistently achieve hiring targets across assigned geographies.
* Reduce time\-to\-hire while maintaining candidate quality.
* Build strong talent pipelines for priority regions.
* Improve onboarding readiness and reduce delays between hiring and deployment.
* Partner closely with the Host Community team to ensure hiring keeps pace with business growth.

 Alongside our global campuses, we also collaborate with talented contractors and freelancers from all over the world to help us achieve our crazy big goals.  This role is a 12\-month engagement, working full\-time hours.

**What you'd be doing in this role**
 As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve. At the moment, this role is focused on:
   

  

* Labelling, annotating, and evaluating photos, graphics, videos, stickers, and designs in Hindi — assessing linguistic quality, accuracy, and cultural appropriateness
* Evaluating AI\-generated content against Canva's quality bar for Hindi users, helping shape how AI experiences land in your language

**You're probably a match if**
* You're a native Hindi speaker with strong written and spoken English — you can move fluidly between both languages with confidence
* You sweat the details — inconsistencies catch your eye and you hold yourself to a high quality bar even on repetitive tasks
* You're self\-directed and can manage your own time across multiple concurrent projects without needing to be chased
* You're adaptable — you can pick up new guidelines quickly and apply them consistently across different task types
* You're genuinely curious about AI and excited to be part of building language experiences that work for Hindi users
* You thrive in a fast\-paced environment where the work evolves and no two weeks look exactly the same

 Canva's Localisation team sits within the International Supergroup and is responsible for bringing Canva's product and AI experiences to users in their language, across the world. With international users representing almost 60% of Canva's user base, localisation is a core strategic priority. We partner closely with the CORE Research and AI Platform teams to deliver in\-language AI evaluations, dataset creation, and quality assurance across Canva's pioneer markets.

 The position requires close collaboration with Unix administrators, application owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, Lines of Business, and change management teams to ensure patching activities are planned, implemented, validated, and documented effectively.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Change Coordination \& Implementation
   

  

* Coordinate monthly and emergency Unix/Linux patch implementation activities across the enterprise environment
* Plan patching schedules and maintain implementation calendars to support operational readiness
* Create, track, and manage change requests in accordance with approved change management procedures
* Coordinate outage windows, bridge calls, approvals, and implementation tasks with relevant teams
* Provide timely status updates throughout patch implementation windows
* Track patch implementation outcomes, including successful completions, failures, cancellations, and remediation actions
* Ensure implementation documentation is complete, accurate, and compliant with governance requirements


 Patching Operations Support
   

  

* Support enterprise Unix/Linux patching activities and assist with implementation coordination
* Coordinate with infrastructure and application teams to confirm patch readiness and validation requirements
* Monitor implementation progress and escalate risks, blockers, or delays as required
* Support post\-patch validation activities, including operational health checks and follow\-up actions
* Maintain accurate patching schedules, implementation trackers, and server inventory details


 Vulnerability \& Compliance Management
   

  

* Support vulnerability remediation by coordinating patch deployment using approved patch baselines
* Track vulnerability remediation progress, compliance status, and related operational metrics
* Assist in maintaining enterprise patch compliance targets and remediation timelines
* Prepare compliance reports and leadership dashboards to support operational reviews
* Monitor exception management activities and track remediation actions to closure


 Reporting \& Analytics
   

  

* Develop and maintain operational reports using Microsoft Excel and other reporting tools
* Create dashboards, charts, and presentations for leadership and operational review meetings
* Analyze patching trends, compliance performance, and implementation effectiveness
* Prepare weekly, monthly, and executive\-level status reports with clear insights and action items
* Support audit reporting, governance reviews, and evidence collection activities


 Stakeholder Communication
   

  

* Manage communications with application owners, business stakeholders, and technical teams
* Provide implementation notifications, progress updates, completion summaries, and follow\-up communications
* Facilitate effective communication during patch windows, bridge calls, and incident situations
* Support leadership reviews, operational meetings, and stakeholder discussions with accurate updates


 Service Management \& Governance
   

  

* Ensure adherence to ITIL\-based service management and operational governance processes
* Support incident, problem, and change management processes, including documentation and follow\-up
* Maintain accurate implementation records, operational documentation, and audit evidence
* Assist with operational risk assessments, exception reviews, and governance\-related follow\-up actions


 Server Onboarding \& Service Enablement
   

  

* Coordinate the onboarding of new servers into the CVPI patching service
* Validate patch readiness, tooling availability, ownership details, and inventory alignment
* Coordinate onboarding requests with application owners and infrastructure teams to ensure service readiness
* Support lifecycle management activities related to patching services and operational support


 Automation \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Support patch automation initiatives and continuous improvement opportunities
* Assist with automated reporting, data collection, and operational tracking activities
* Identify process improvement opportunities to increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve reporting accuracy
* Support BigFix, Red Hat Satellite, and related patch management platforms where applicable


**Experience**
 Required Qualifications
   

  

* 5–10 years of experience in IT services, infrastructure support, or enterprise operations environments
* Minimum 2 years of experience working with ITIL processes, service management practices, vulnerability management, and patch management activities


 Mandatory Skills
   

  

* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including\~
+ VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP
+ Pivot Tables
+ Charts and Dashboards
+ Data Analysis and Reporting

* Strong analytical, reporting, and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent documentation, presentation, and stakeholder communication skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to provide clear operational updates
* Basic understanding of Unix/Linux operating systems, distributions, and version management
* Working knowledge of ITIL processes and service management governance
* Experience using change management, service delivery, and operational tracking tools
* Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders, implementation activities, timelines, and priorities effectively


**Preferred Skills**
* Hands\-on experience with ServiceNow or similar IT service management platforms
* Experience in change management, project coordination, or service management functions
* Exposure to Unix/Linux system administration and enterprise infrastructure support
* Knowledge of vulnerability management, compliance tracking, and remediation processes
* Experience supporting enterprise patch management processes and implementation governance
* Understanding of automation tools, operational reporting platforms, and process improvement methods


**Preferred Certifications**

* Linux/Unix certifications are an added advantage

FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

title: SAP Basis-Senior
description:

 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Your expertise will be essential in maintaining system health, ensuring compliance with IT policies, and supporting disaster recovery and business continuity efforts.
   

  

 In this role, you will also provide guidance and mentorship to junior BASIS team members, fostering knowledge sharing and professional growth. You will be part of a collaborative team that values technical excellence and innovation, delivering reliable SAP BASIS services to support business operations
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

* System /System copy
* ABAP \+ Java\-dual stack
* Add\-on and Support Pack application and troubleshooting
* Kernel Upgrade
* Client copies and export\-import
* TMS administration and configuration and troubleshooting Transport errors
* SAP system monitoring and thorough analysis of issues
* SAP parameter change, operation mode setup, Logon group setup
* SAP Role based Authorization knowledge \- Role creation and modification
* Spool administration and troubleshooting spool/printer issues
* OSS Note application
* Experience in Single \-Sign On, Web Dispatcher
* Experience in working SAP on public cloud and private cloud.
* Experience in working with cloud service providers like AWS, Azure and GCP.
* SAP Solution Manager experience with basic and advanced configuration.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP user provisioning, authorization troubleshooting, and role assignments.
* Basic knowledge of OS/DB migration processes.
* Familiarity with Web Dispatcher, Gateway, and SAP integration components.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Should have 4 to 7 years of experience in SAP Basis domain.
* Solid hands\-on experience in SAP system administration, including installation, configuration, upgrades, and performance optimization.
* Should understand SAP architecture, transport management, kernel updates, and system refresh processes.
* Proficient in administering SAP HANA (monitoring, tuning, backup/recoveries, basic troubleshooting).
* Experience supporting landscapes like S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, PO/PI, Fiori, Solution Manager, etc.
* Strong SAP BTP knowledge, including key services, integration patterns, and administration fundamentals.
* Strong working experience with RISE with SAP environments and operational activities.
* Strong documentation skills for system delivery, ensuring clear, structured, and audit‑ready technical documentation.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with clients and stakeholders.
* Knowledge of Solution Manager features such as CHARM, EWA, and monitoring.


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Practical experience managing SAP workloads on Azure or AWS (VMs, storage classes, networking, monitoring).
* Exposure to SAP Cloud ALM (CALM) for monitoring, change control, and operations.
* Exposure to SAP Data Archiving with OpenText


**Certifications:**
* SAP Technology Associate certifications (SAP Basis or HANA).
* SAP Cloud Certifications (RISE, BTP, HANA Cloud, etc.).
* Cloud certification (AWS, Azure and GCP).
* Exposure to enterprise transformation tools such as Signavio and LeanIX for process modeling, architecture governance, and landscape documentation.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.

title: EOS Service Execution Specialist
description:
**We help the world run better**
 At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.
   

  

 Enhanced Operations Service Specialist plays a pivotal role within the SAP PCO – Global Cloud Operation Delivery (GCO) \- Enhanced Operations Service (EOS) organization, serving as a trusted advisor responsible for safeguarding and optimizing strategic customers' investments in SAP Enterprise Cloud Services.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced SAP technology professional expert for the Enhanced Operations Service (EOS) team who should have a proven track record in at least in one of the areas like SAP Basis, HANA DB, Server management, Critical Situation Handling, Project Management, with a strong technical and process background. A customer first mindset is a must.
   

  

 As an EOS Execution Service Senior Specialist \- you are responsible for:
   

  

* Ensure the execution of planned changes requested by customers are completed as per the activity schedule, tracking, and achieving various ambitious service KPI and SLA’s.
* Own and execute customer service requests, system build, migration, and operational activities across Basis, DB, and Server domains — meeting SLA/KPI commitments with a customer\-first mindset.
* Involve in migration activities including system copies, OS/DB migrations, cutover planning, and go\-live support.
* Adhoc/Immediate execution of customer service request which are critical during special phases of the customer life cycle.
* Quick responses during escalations, ensure no service requests are impacted in the delivery phase, identifying and driving initiatives to improve the customer operations.
* Analyse customer feedback on the service request execution quality and bring about changes in a more structured and time bound manner.
* Drive feedback relevant to procedure and process with relevant teams and drive it to completion.
* Coordinate and orchestrate the work between the various teams with Strong collaboration with other units within and outside Enterprise Cloud Service units.
* Bring in Continuous Improvement Initiatives, to address customer pain points and enhancements in the Service Delivery
* Process improvement initiatives for daily operational activities
* Streamline standard operating procedures by focussing on automation enhancements.
* Experience with AI and AI tools would be an added advantage.


**What You’ll Build**
* Excellent hands\-on experience in one of the areas like SAP Basis, Lifecycle events (Upgrades / Updates). Support Knowledge of products like SAP Cloud\-Connector, S4 would be an added advantage.
* Practical knowledge with SAP technologies like SAP NetWeaver, Business Objects, SAP HANA and SAP Sybase Adaptive Server Enterprise (ASE)
* Experience with Managed/Hosting services or SAP Private Cloud or Public Cloud Operations/Support is preferred.
* Working knowledge on SAP Application Security, System Copies, DB export\-import, and disaster recovery strategy, client administration is preferred.
* Experience in working with Linux pacemaker environment is added advantage.


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in one of the following areas: Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technologies Management.
* 6 to 9 years of work experience as a Technical SAP NetWeaver Consultant (ABAP and Java Basis Administration)
* Hands\-on expertise in SAP Basis administration, SAP NetWeaver, SAP HANA \& basic experience in Sybase ASE, and Business Objects.
* Good knowledge of S/4HANA architecture, additionally migration paths, high availability, and disaster recovery strategies knowledge is a plus.
* Experience with hyperscale cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and managed/private cloud operations.
* Practicl knowledge in Linux/UNIX, Linux Pacemaker and automation tools.
* Basic knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, NAT, firewalls, LDAP) and storage.
* Familiarity with additional SAP technologies: Cloud Connector, Content Server, OpenText, IDM, TREX, MDM, and others.
* ITIL framework exposure; SAP S/4HANA conversion and OS/DB migration trainings are added advantage
* 24\*7 support model. Rotational 2 shift support of APJ and EMEA time zone. Rotational weekend support
* Analytical and solution\-oriented thinking
* Strong customer service focus with customer first Mindset.


**Where You Belong**
 SAP Private Cloud Operation (PCO) is part of the Customer Services \& Delivery board area in SAP. Enterprise Cloud Services is a business unit focusing on delivery of managed private cloud services. To provide our customers with the right level of service, we have Technical and customer facing roles within the unit along with technical delivery.
   

  

 The Enhanced Operation Service is part of SAP PCO GCO Delivery organization. This is a dedicated team which will focus on leading and optimizing strategic customers’ end\-to\-end delivery and operation model, during the customer’s cloud transformation journey. We provide a spectrum of cloud deployment options for our customers with our own infrastructure, our partners and through public cloud infrastructures.
   

  

 \#ITT2, \#SAPECSCareers, \#SAPReturnshipIndiaCareers

 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements.

title: Systems Engineering  Advisor - Endpoint Management-Patch/Deployment/SCCM Analyst
description:
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Systems Engineering Advisor \- Endpoint Management\-Patch/Deployment/SCCM Analyst to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN\-KA), India (IN).
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced SCCM/Intune Lead Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This lead\-level role combines deep technical expertise with delivery ownership — driving complex SCCM/Intune engagements, leading technical teams, architecting enterprise endpoint solutions, and serving as a key client\-facing technical authority for EPM workstreams from India. The Lead Engineer plays a critical role in NTT DATA's EPM service delivery quality, client satisfaction, and practice capability growth, supporting global accounts across the US, Europe, and APAC.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Technical Leadership \& Architecture
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end design and implementation of enterprise SCCM/ConfigMgr and Microsoft Intune environments for global client accounts.
* Architect co\-management strategies, Autopilot provisioning frameworks, and Modern Management transition roadmaps.
* Own the technical direction for SCCM\-to\-Intune migration engagements including workload transition planning, timeline development, and risk mitigation.
* Define EPM platform standards, governance frameworks, and configuration baselines across multiple global accounts managed from India.
* Evaluate emerging Microsoft Endpoint Manager capabilities and provide technical roadmap recommendations to delivery managers and clients.


 Enterprise Patch Management
   

  

* Own enterprise\-level patch management programs — governing policy, SLAs, exception management, and compliance reporting across 10,000\+ endpoint fleets.
* Design and manage Intune Expedite policies, WUfB rings, and SCCM ADR\-based patching for complex multi\-site global environments.
* Lead vulnerability remediation programs integrating Qualys/Tenable findings with SCCM/Intune patch deployment cycles.
* Develop patching governance documentation, escalation playbooks, and compliance dashboards for client and internal stakeholders.
* Lead emergency and zero\-day patching response including containment, deployment, and post\-incident review from India delivery centre.


 Advanced OS Deployment \& Provisioning
   

  

* Lead enterprise Windows 11 migration programs including readiness assessment, task sequence design, pilot execution, and phased rollout.
* Design and deliver Windows Autopilot \+ Intune Zero Touch Provisioning frameworks for large\-scale global device refresh programs.
* Own OSD platform operations — WinPE environments, MDT integration, driver library management, and image currency.
* Architect golden image build pipelines, compliance validation, and automated post\-deployment configuration.
* Define device lifecycle management policies from procurement through decommission for managed global client environments.


 Automation \& Integration
   

  

* Architect PowerShell\-based automation frameworks for SCCM and Intune operational efficiency and compliance reporting.
* Lead development of Microsoft Graph API integrations for Intune bulk operations, automated policy enforcement, and reporting.
* Design SCCM SQL/Power BI reporting solutions for delivery management and client\-level visibility into endpoint health and patch posture.
* Oversee integration between EPM platforms and security tooling (Qualys, Defender for Endpoint) for holistic endpoint health management.


 Client Engagement \& Delivery Governance
   

  

* Serve as primary technical point of contact for assigned EPM accounts — leading governance calls, delivery reviews, and escalation resolution from India.
* Drive SLA attainment, delivery quality, and continuous improvement across managed global endpoint accounts.
* Contribute to SOW development, effort estimation, and technical proposal documentation for new and expanding EPM engagements.
* Mentor and develop Grade 7–9 engineers through technical coaching, design reviews, and structured capability building.
* Collaborate with NTT DATA India practice leadership and onshore counterparts on EPM service development and client strategies.


**Required Skills**
* Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — site architecture, hierarchy design, OSD, patch management, reporting (expert)
* Microsoft Intune — full MDM/MAM lifecycle, co\-management, Autopilot, WUfB, Conditional Access (expert)
* Windows 10/11 enterprise deployment — task sequences, MDT, WinPE, driver management, ZTP Autopilot
* Azure AD / Entra ID — identity\-driven EPM, Conditional Access, MFA, device trust, RBAC
* PowerShell advanced automation — SCCM SDK, Graph API, reporting pipelines, operational tooling
* SQL Server \+ Power BI — SCCM database reporting, compliance dashboards, management\-level visualizations
* Vulnerability management — Qualys/Tenable integration with patch management lifecycle
* Client\-facing delivery governance from India — SLA management, delivery reviews, escalation ownership


**About NTT DATA**
 NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. title: Staff Support Engineer ( L4 )

 **Staff Software Development Support Engineer** 
 to be part of making this happen.
   

  

  

  

**About The Role**
 Arctic Wolf Networks, Inc. (AWN) is seeking a Staff Software Development Support Engineer to join our Software Development Support (SDS) organisation. As a senior individual contributor, you set technical direction for complex customer\-impacting investigations, lead escalations, and raise the bar for diagnostics and operability across Product and R\&D.
   

  

 You operate end‑to‑end on the hardest problems spanning software, infrastructure, and cloud. You guide technical approach, shape observability and diagnostics strategy, and coordinate cross\-team execution to accelerate root‑cause identification and durable fixes—including authoring or reviewing critical PRs when appropriate.
   

  

 Beyond resolving incidents, you mentor SDS engineers, lead technical design and postmortem reviews, and drive systemic improvements that eliminate classes of defects and reduce toil across teams.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include**
* Own and drive complex, escalated issues from intake through resolution
* Perform deep technical troubleshooting across software, cloud, and infrastructure layers
* Analyze logs, metrics, and telemetry across distributed systems
* Perform advanced debugging, including:
* Application and service log analysis
* Memory dump and crash analysis (e.g., WinDbg)
* Performance tracing and system\-level diagnostics
* Kernel debugging (Windows, Mac, Linux \- in that order)
* Reproduce issues by building scripts, automation, and test environments
* Work across AWS, Azure, and local environments supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux
* Partner with R\&D teams to log high\-quality defects, provide reproduction data, and propose fixes
* Submit and review pull requests for fixes, observability improvements, and tooling
* Identify recurring issues and drive automation and process improvements
* Collaborate with Support, Product, Problem Management, and Principal Engineers on large\-scale investigations
* Contribute feedback to architectural designs, diagnostics strategy, and data flow improvements
* Document findings, workflows, and technical learnings to improve operational maturity
* Please note: This role may involve on\-call responsibilities and light travel.


**About You**
 You are a technically curious, engineering\-minded problem solver who enjoys working on ambiguous and challenging issues.
   

  

**You Bring**
* Strong troubleshooting skills across software and systems
* Experience reading, debugging, and modifying code
* Background in networking, security, or distributed systems
* Strong ownership mindset—comfortable driving issues independently
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Comfort working without scripted procedures


**Technical Experience (Preferred)**
* Linux and multi\-platform OS experience (Windows, macOS, Linux)
* Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure)
* Observability tooling (Elastic Stack, Kibana, logging pipelines)
* Scripting and automation (PowerShell, Python, Bash, Ruby)
* Databases and data platforms (MS SQL, MySQL, Athena, Databricks)
* Containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Ticketing and collaboration tools (Zendesk, Jira)
* Memory dump and performance analysis tools (WinDbg, ETW/XPerf)
* Experience with debugging AM\-PPL kernel driver
* Experience with REST APIs


 Security experience is preferred but not required. We provide comprehensive cybersecurity training during onboarding and throughout your career.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 10\+ years in software development or related role.


**Environment and Physical Demands**
* Work is primarily sedentary in nature and can be executed in sitting or standing positions in an office environment.
* Requires the ability to utilize technology, including using a keyboard, verbal communication, and working with device screens that require visual acuity.
* If located in a company office, mobility is required to physically navigate the space.
* In the event of business travel, mobility is sufficient to use public and private transport and navigate to essential locations.
* May include moving or lifting 25 pounds or less (e.g., office chair, reams of paper).


**On\-Camera Policy**
 To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location\-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.
   

  

 At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021\-2025\), Best Places to Work – USA (2021\-2025\), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021\-2024\), Great Place to Work – UK (2024\-2026\), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024\-2026\). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.
   

  

  

  

**Our Values**
 Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion, and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good.
   

  

  

  

 We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here.
   

  

  

  

 We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities.
   

  

 All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:
   

  

* Equity for all employees
* Flexible annual leave, paid holidays and volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
* Fertility support and paid parental leave


 Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. Arctic Wolf is committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, respectful, and inclusive environment ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. As such, we strive to make our entire experience as accessible as possible and provide accommodations as required for candidates and employees with disabilities and/or other specific needs where possible. Please let us know if you require any accommodation by emailing recruiting@arcticwolf.com.   View our Hiring Page to learn more about our application process.
   

  

  

  

**Security Requirements**
* Conducts duties and responsibilities in accordance with AWN’s Information Security policies, standards, processes, and controls to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of AWN business information (in accordance with our employee handbook and corporate policies).
* Background checks are required for this position.
* This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (“EAR”).  Please note that, if applicable, an offer for employment will be conditioned on authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export control laws and regulations.

title: Digital &  Performance Marketer

About Circled Advisory
 



 Circled Advisory is building Circled Plus, Bangalore's first invite\-only private listing platform for luxury homes, along with Circled Intelligence (CI), our proprietary pricing and decision engine designed to help buyers understand what a property is actually worth and make more informed buying decisions.

 Experience: Minimum 2 year of hands\-on experience in digital marketing or performance marketing. Experience in real estate or at a digital marketing agency handling real estate clients is a plus.
 



  





 About the Role
 



 We are looking for someone who can execute, analyse and solve problems not someone who simply completes assigned tasks.
 



 You will work across performance marketing, content, analytics, CRM, automation, website and digital engagement.
 



 The expectation is to constantly look beyond execution:
 



  





 Why did performance drop? Where are leads leaking? Is tracking working correctly? Can a workflow be improved? What should we change next? We want someone who can identify a problem, investigate it, take action and measure the outcome.
 



  





 What You’ll Do
 


* Support and optimise campaigns across Meta, LinkedIn, Google and other digital channels.
* Track CPL, CTR, CPC, conversions, lead quality and overall funnel performance.
* Analyse campaign data and turn insights into clear actions, experiments and improvements.
* Use Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity to understand traffic, user behaviour, drop\-offs and conversion issues.

* Work with platforms such as Sell.Do, AiSensy, Brevo, CallerDesk and Pabbly to improve lead management, communication and marketing workflows.
* Manage WhatsApp marketing, email marketing, social media engagement and customer databases
* Support website blogs, LinkedIn content, SEO, backlink building and landing\-page improvements.
* Create and adapt campaign creatives, social posts, newsletters, brochures, floor plans and other branded marketing assets. Support video and reel editing where required.
* Identify broken processes, integrations, tracking issues or inefficient workflows and coordinate with developers or vendors to resolve them
* Continuously look for opportunities to make our digital marketing systems simpler, faster and more effective



  





 Who You Are
 


* 2–3 years of hands\-on digital or performance marketing experience.
* Strong analytical mindset and comfortable working with numbers.
* Able to turn data into actions rather than simply preparing reports.
* Naturally curious when something isn't working and willing to investigate why.
* Comfortable taking ownership without waiting for detailed instructions.
* Working knowledge of Canva, Photoshop or similar creative tools.
* Familiar with performance marketing, analytics, CRM and automation tools.
* Comfortable learning new platforms and solving digital issues independently.
* Organised, proactive and comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment.



  





 Most importantly, we are looking for someone who notices problems before being asked to look for them
 



  





 Why Join Circled
 


* Work on some of Bangalore's most exclusive luxury residential opportunities
* Your ideas can move from discussion to live execution quickly
* High ownership with room to experiment, learn, and solve real marketing problems
* Opportunity to grow from assisting campaigns to independently owning campaigns and larger parts of the digital marketing function
* Small team, direct founder exposure, and zero unnecessary corporate layers



  





 Other Details

title: Prior authorization expert
description:
**Location:**

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time

 Night Shift – U.S. Time Zone (7:30 PM–4:30 AM IST)
 



  





  





**About Us** 




 Lenity Health is a mission\-driven healthcare organization focused on creating exceptional experiences for patients, providers, and care teams across the U.S. healthcare ecosystem.
 



 We help physician practices and healthcare systems improve efficiency, care quality, and scalability by combining skilled healthcare professionals with intelligent technology. With teams in the United States and India, Lenity Health brings deep experience in clinical operations, value\-based care, and health technology.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The Virtual Medical Assistant – Prior Authorization will support U.S.\-based physician practices by managing prior authorization, denial, appeal, and referral workflows.
 



 This role requires someone who is detail\-oriented, proactive, and comfortable navigating payer portals, EHR systems, and insurance requirements. The ideal candidate can manage a high volume of cases accurately while communicating clearly with providers, care teams, and patients.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Submit and track prior authorization requests for medications, procedures, imaging, and durable medical equipment (DME) through payer portals such as Availity and CoverMyMeds, as well as by phone or fax when required.
* Review clinical documentation to ensure medical necessity and payer\-specific criteria are met before submitting requests.
* Follow up on pending, denied, and expiring authorizations to avoid delays in patient care.
* Review denial reasons, identify root causes, and determine the appropriate appeal pathway.
* Draft and submit appeal letters with relevant clinical documentation.
* Process and coordinate referral requests in accordance with practice and payer requirements.
* Communicate authorization status, documentation requirements, and delays clearly to providers, care teams, front\-desk staff, and patients.
* Coordinate with billing, clinical, and administrative teams to obtain missing documentation or information.
* Maintain accurate documentation, authorization status updates, and productivity trackers.
* Meet daily productivity benchmarks, turnaround\-time expectations, and quality standards.
* Participate in quality audits and incorporate feedback to improve accuracy and workflow performance.
* Follow all SOPs, HIPAA requirements, data\-security standards, and patient confidentiality protocols.
* Identify urgent cases, workflow bottlenecks, and recurring denial trends, and escalate concerns appropriately.
* Collaborate effectively with U.S.\-based providers and internal teams across time zones.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Medical sciences background required, including BDS, MBBS, BHMS, BAMS, Nursing, Life Sciences, or an equivalent degree.
* At least 2 years of experience in prior authorization, insurance verification, medical billing, referrals, or another payer\-facing U.S. healthcare role.
* Strong understanding of commercial insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, plan structures, and payer requirements.
* Working knowledge of medical billing and coding terminology, including CPT, ICD\-10, and HCPCS codes.
* Experience working with payer portals such as Availity and CoverMyMeds.
* Familiarity with EHR systems such as eClinicalWorks, Athenahealth, Epic, or similar platforms.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to interpret payer criteria and identify appeal opportunities.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and comfortable managing a high volume of cases.
* Strong ownership, reliability, and willingness to learn and adopt new technologies.

title: Reconciliation Specialist
description:
**Role: With Imagineers Group working with Goldman Sachs** 




**Location:** 
 Bangalore, onsite 5 days a week.
 



  





**Opportunity to work with some very smart people and test your abilities and grow your potential** 




  





**Job Overview:** 




**Account \& Transaction Reconciliation Analyst – Credit Cards** 




 We are seeking a team of analytical and detail\-oriented professional to support a targeted review of approximately several thousand credit card accounts. The role will focus on investigating account and transaction\-level activity, tracing the movement of funds across systems, reconciling transaction histories, and determining whether individual accounts require further review for potential escheatment.
 



 This is a hands\-on analytical role requiring strong accounting and reconciliation skills, attention to detail, and the ability to investigate transactions across multiple systems and reach a clear, evidence\-based conclusion.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Perform detailed reviews of approximately several thousand credit card accounts and their associated transaction activity.
* Investigate individual transactions to understand the complete movement of funds, including the origin, destination, timing, and nature of each transaction.
* Use AUI, Appian and WebCSR to research account histories and trace transaction activity across relevant systems.
* Reconcile account\-level and transaction\-level information across multiple data sources and identify inconsistencies, breaks, or unexplained balances.
* Review supporting account information and transaction trails to establish a clear and documented understanding of account activity.
* Determine whether reviewed accounts meet defined criteria for further escheatment review or follow\-up.
* Document investigation steps, evidence reviewed, conclusions reached, and any outstanding issues in a consistent and auditable manner.
* Escalate exceptions, unusual transaction patterns, data discrepancies, or cases where a clear conclusion cannot be reached.
* Work through a defined population of accounts while maintaining accuracy and meeting agreed productivity and quality standards.
* Coordinate with project stakeholders and subject matter experts to resolve questions and ensure cases are progressed appropriately.
* Provide clear updates on review progress, issues, dependencies, and emerging themes.



  





**Required Experience and Skills** 



* 1–3 years of relevant professional experience in accounting, financial operations, reconciliation, transaction analysis, banking operations, or a related area.
* Strong accounting and reconciliation capabilities, with the ability to follow financial activity through a series of transactions.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to investigate detailed account information systematically.
* High level of accuracy and attention to detail when working with financial and transactional data.
* Ability to interpret transaction histories and distinguish between normal account activity, exceptions, and items requiring further investigation.
* Strong written communication skills, particularly the ability to document findings and conclusions clearly.
* Strong verbal communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage a significant case population while maintaining consistent review standards.
* Comfortable working across multiple applications and data sources to complete an investigation.
* Proficiency with Excel and other standard analytical and productivity tools.



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* Previous experience within the credit card or consumer banking business.
* Experience reviewing credit card account or transaction\-level data.
* Exposure to reconciliation, payments, account servicing, financial operations, unclaimed property, or escheatment processes.
* Experience with AUI, Appian and/or WebCSR is advantageous.
* Experience working within a regulated financial services environment is preferred.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 The successful candidate will be able to take an individual account, reconstruct and understand its relevant transaction history, reconcile the available information, and produce a clear conclusion supported by evidence. The role requires someone who is comfortable investigating transactions in detail rather than simply processing cases.
 



 Each transaction review is currently estimated to require approximately 30 minutes, so the ability to work methodically and efficiently across a substantial review population will be important.
 



 This role would suit someone early in their career who has developed a solid grounding in accounting, reconciliation or banking operations and wants to apply those skills to a focused financial investigation and remediation program.
 



  





**Location:** 
 On\-site in Bangalore, 5 days a week.

title: Web scraping Engineer (Immediate joiners preferred)
description:
**Company Description** 




 AIMLEAP is a global AI development and technology consulting company specializing in end\-to\-end full\-stack solutions at the intersection of AI, data engineering, and software development. With over 14 years of industry experience, AIMLEAP has co\-created more than 50 successful products and enabled over 750 businesses worldwide in their digital transformation journeys. The organization is CMMI Level 3 apprised and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified, underscoring a strong commitment to quality, performance, scalability, and security. Recognized as a Great Place to Work®, AIMLEAP operates global delivery centers in the USA, Canada, India, and Australia, offering services that range from AI\-powered data management and web scraping to advanced analytics and automation. The company builds and maintains AI and data platforms such as RADAR, PRICELEAP, and Rapid Extract, providing real\-time insights and clean web data for smarter decision\-making.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are looking for a
 **hands\-on Web Scraping / Crawling Engineer** 
 with
 **3–5 years of experience** 
 in web scraping, browser automation, and scalable data extraction.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should have strong experience working with
 **dynamic and JavaScript\-heavy websites** 
 , building reliable crawling workflows, handling crawling failures, and working with distributed processing systems.This is a highly technical, hands\-on role. You will be expected to
 **design, develop, debug, optimize, and maintain web crawling and data extraction systems** 
 .
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Design, develop, and maintain
 **scalable web crawling and scraping systems** 
 for dynamic and JavaScript\-heavy websites.
* Develop browser automation workflows using
 **Playwright, Selenium, Puppeteer, or similar frameworks** 
 .
* Investigate and resolve crawling issues such as
 **403/429 responses, redirects, timeouts, rendering failures, session issues, and anti\-bot challenges** 
 .
* Develop robust
 **retry, fallback, and failure\-handling mechanisms** 
 to improve crawler reliability.
* Work with
 **cookies, sessions, browser contexts, headers, proxies, and related crawling mechanisms** 
 to maintain state and improve crawling reliability.
* Build and optimize
 **concurrent and distributed scraping workflows** 
 using asynchronous processing, queues, and worker\-based architectures.
* Design data pipelines covering
 **URL processing, crawling, extraction, validation, transformation, and storage** 
 .
* Optimize crawler performance, including
 **concurrency, browser lifecycle, resource utilization, timeouts, and request handling** 
 .
* Implement monitoring and observability for
 **crawl success rates, failure types, latency, retries, and worker performance** 
 .
* Debug complex crawling problems and identify
 **root causes rather than relying only on one\-off fixes** 
 .
* Develop reusable crawling components and frameworks that can support multiple websites and use cases.
* Collaborate with data engineering, AI, backend, and product teams to deliver reliable and structured web data.
* Evaluate and adopt new
 **web crawling, browser automation, and data extraction technologies** 
 where appropriate.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




  




* **3–5 years of hands\-on experience** 
 in web scraping, web crawling, browser automation, or web data engineering.
* Strong programming experience in
 **Python** 
 . JavaScript/Node.js is a plus.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Scrapy,
 **Playwright, Selenium, Puppeteer, or similar browser automation frameworks** 
 .
* Strong understanding of
 **HTTP, HTML, DOM, JavaScript rendering, redirects, cookies, sessions, headers, and browser contexts** 
 .
* Experience with
 **browser fingerprinting, WAFs, and modern anti\-bot mechanisms** 
 .
* Experience working with
 **dynamic, JavaScript\-heavy, and asynchronous websites** 
 .
* Good understanding of
 **asynchronous programming, concurrency, and parallel processing** 
 .
* Experience with
 **job queues, distributed workers, or message\-based processing systems** 
 such as Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Celery, or similar technologies.
* Understanding of
 **retry mechanisms, error handling, idempotency, rate limiting, and backpressure** 
 in distributed systems.
* Hands\-on experience with
 **proxy management, session handling, and anti\-bot challenges** 
 .
* Strong debugging and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate and resolve complex crawling failures.
* Experience working with
 **SQL databases** 
 such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
* Familiarity with
 **Docker and cloud platforms** 
 such as AWS, GCP, or Azure is a plus.



  





**Good to Have** 




  




* Experience with
 **Redis Streams, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Celery, or other distributed processing technologies** 
 .
* Experience processing
 **large volumes of URLs or web data** 
 .
* Experience with
 **AWS S3 or S3\-compatible object storage** 
 .
* Experience building
 **ETL/data processing pipelines** 
 .
* Experience with
 **LLM\-based data extraction or structured data extraction** 
 .
* Experience with
 **crawler monitoring, logging, metrics, and observability** 
 .



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




  




* Strong
 **hands\-on engineering mindset** 
 rather than purely project or delivery management experience.
* Ability to independently
 **debug, investigate, and solve difficult crawling problems** 
 .
* Strong understanding of how browsers, HTTP requests, sessions, and websites interact.
* Ability to design systems that are
 **reliable, scalable, and fault tolerant** 
 .
* Good understanding of how to distribute and coordinate large\-scale scraping workloads.
* Ability to identify the root cause of crawling failures and develop
 **generalized, reusable solutions** 
 .
* Willingness to work across
 **scraping, backend services, distributed processing, data pipelines, and infrastructure** 
 when required.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and curiosity to understand how websites behave rather than relying solely on existing scraping tools.



  





**Education** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
* Equivalent practical experience in software engineering or web scraping will also be considered.

title: Payroll Associate
description:
**Overview**
 The Payroll Analyst / Associate will play a critical role in supporting end\-to\-end payroll processing for a dynamic workforce in a multi\-disciplinary engineering environment. The individual will be responsible for ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timeliness of payroll while managing complexities such as shift\-based workforce, variable components, statutory adherence, and audit readiness.
   

  

 Your role
   

  

* End\-to\-End Payroll Execution:
+ Support processing of monthly payroll cycles including validation of inputs such as new joiners, exits, increments, bonuses, overtime, and shift allowances.
+ Manage Full \& Final settlements (F\&F) including leave encashment, gratuity, and recoveries.
+ Validate payroll outputs ensuring alignment with company policies and statutory norms.

* Statutory Compliance \& Governance:
+ Ensure compliance with Indian labour and payroll regulations including:
- Provident Fund (PF).
- Employee State Insurance (ESI).
- Professional Tax (PT).
- Labour Welfare Fund (LWF).
- Income Tax (TDS).

+ Support statutory filings, reconciliations, and returns.
+ Assist in responding to internal/external audits and compliance reviews.
+ Maintain proper documentation and audit trails for payroll transactions.

* Data Management, Validation \& Reporting:
+ Perform data validation and reconciliation of payroll inputs/outputs.
+ Prepare and analyse payroll reports, variance analysis, and MIS dashboards.
+ Maintain payroll trackers, master data, and employee records in HRMS/payroll systems.
+ Support cost analysis and budgeting inputs related to employee compensation.

* Stakeholder Management:
+ Collaborate closely with HRBPs, Finance and Operations teams for payroll inputs and validations.
+ Address employee payroll queries related to salary, taxation, and deductions.
+ Ensure seamless coordination for high employee volume and multi\-location payroll processing.

* Process Improvement \& Automation:
+ Identify opportunities for process optimization and automation within payroll operations.
+ Support implementation/enhancement of payroll systems (e.g., Workday, Oracle).
+ Contribute to standardization of payroll processes and SOP documentation.


**About You**
* Education:
+ Master's degree in Commerce / Finance / Business Administration (preferred).

* Experience:
+ 2–3 years of relevant experience in Indian payroll processing, preferably with bigger MNC.
+ Exposure to handling large employee base and complex salary structures.

* Technical \& Functional Skills:
+ Strong understanding of:
- CTC structuring, earnings, deductions, reimbursements.
- Statutory components and compliance frameworks.

+ Advanced proficiency in MS Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data validation, reconciliation).
+ Hands\-on experience in payroll/HRMS systems (Workday / Oracle preferred).
+ Experience in payroll reconciliation, reporting, and audit support.

* Behavioural Competencies:
+ High attention to detail and strong analytical mindset.
+ Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with integrity.
+ Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
+ Ability to work in structured, deadline\-driven environments.
+ Proactive, adaptable, and collaborative team player.


 Rewards \& benefits
   

  

 Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.

title: Global Payroll Operations Specialist - ANZ
description:
**About Rippling**
 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
   

  

 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
   

  

 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
   

  

 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a payroll operations specialist to join Rippling’s Global Payroll Operations team. We are rapidly expanding Rippling to serve the needs of employees and employers all over the world. This team plays a critical role in ensuring the success of our payroll platform, which is natively built and fully integrated with Rippling’s broader suite of products.
   

  

 As Rippling expands its product offerings globally, there is a critical business need for Rippling to build strong operational coverage, country\-specific payroll expertise, and scalable processes across key markets.
   

  

 This role, Global Payroll Operations Specialist, is an important hire for the team and will support payroll operations across Australia, New Zealand, and Singapore. The role will manage defined payroll workflows and operational processes across these markets, support statutory payment and filing operations, partner with cross\-functional teams and government agencies as needed to improve payroll quality and operational efficiency.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role for someone who can independently manage their workload, resolve moderately complex payroll and compliance issues with minimal supervision, and help strengthen the processes that support a reliable customer and product experience across APAC.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Manage assigned payroll workflows across Australia, New Zealand, and Singapore, including country\-specific statutory payments, filings, pensions, tax submissions, and recurring payroll deadlines.
* Investigate and resolve customer, tax, filing, and compliance issues; escalate complex matters with clear context, evidence, and recommended next steps.
* Coordinate with relevant government agencies, including the ATO, IRD, IRAS, CPF Board, and Ministry of Manpower, where needed.
* Maintain clear communication with customers, government agencies, and cross\-functional partners, ensuring timely updates and follow\-through on open cases.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Payroll Operations to improve payroll accuracy, product quality, tooling, and operational workflows.
* Create and maintain Jira tickets, case records, audits, reconciliations, documentation, and SOPs so issues and processes can be tracked, resolved, and repeated consistently.


 What you will need
   

  

* 2–5 years of strong payroll operations experience across Australia, New Zealand, and/or Singapore, with demonstrated exposure to country\-specific statutory filings, payments, pensions, tax submissions, year\-end processes, and agency interactions.
* Experience managing payroll cases, customer queries, operational tickets, reconciliations, audits, or recurring payroll deadlines with minimal follow\-up.
* Ability to resolve moderately complex payroll issues, identify root causes, and escalate when deeper subject\-matter or cross\-functional support is needed.
* Strong English written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to keep customers, partners, and internal stakeholders informed on status, context, and next steps.
* High attention to detail and a commitment to quality in time\-sensitive payroll environments, including accurate documentation and practical SOP maintenance.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace or Microsoft Office for data analysis and workflow management; familiarity with Salesforce, Jira, and Confluence is a plus.
* Ability to work Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST) hours, approximately 5:30 AM to 1:30 PM IST.


 Additional Information
   

  

 Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and does not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com.

title: Formal Verification Engineer II
description:
**Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced
 **Formal Verification Engineer** 
 with 4\+ years of expertise in SoC/IP verification using formal methods.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will drive formal verification strategy, develop scalable verification environments, create assertions and properties, perform architectural and RTL verification, and collaborate closely with architects, designers, and DV teams to ensure high\-quality silicon delivery.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define and execute formal verification strategies for complex IPs, subsystems, and SoCs.Develop formal verification plans based on architecture and microarchitecture specifications.
* Create SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA), formal properties, assumptions, covers, and checkers.
* Debug counterexamples and work closely with designers to root\-cause and resolve design issues.
* Drive verification closure through proof convergence, coverage analysis, and methodology improvements.Develop reusable formal verification components, libraries, and automation flows.
* Contribute to formal verification methodology evolution, AI\-assisted verification workflows, and best practices.
* Mentor early career engineers and review verification plans, properties, and results.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including Architecture, RTL Design, DV, Emulation, and Silicon Validation.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* 4\+ years of experience in semiconductor verification with significant focus on Formal Verification.
* Strong understanding of Digital Design FundamentalsComputer Architecture and SoC
* DesignExpertise in SystemVerilog and SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA).
* Hands\-on experience with formal verification tools such as:Cadence JasperGoldSynopsys VC FormalStrong debugging and analytical skills.


 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

title: Senior Test Analyst
description:
**Overview**
 WELCOME TO SITA
   

  

 At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.
   

  

 You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward\-we're proud to be recognized as a
 **Great Place to Work** 
 ® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.
   

  

 Are you ready to love your job?
   

  

 The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
   

  

 PURPOSE
   

  

 Ensures the software is verified and validated against the criteria set out in the functional and non\- functional specifications by defining test cases and ensuring their execution.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Produces test scripts materials and regression test packs to test new and amended software or services.Specifies requirements for environment data resources and tools. Interprets executes and documents complex test scripts using agreed methods and standards.Provides detailed analysis of all testing carried out on the environment ensuring all bugs risks and issues are logged correctly.Actively provides feedback to senior QA management which may result in new working practices or general QA improvements.Mentors coaches and coordinates a small group of less experienced QA Analysts ensuring they have the skills and knowledge in order to perform their roles.
   

  

 Produces test scripts materials and regression test packs to test new and amended software or services.Specifies requirements for environment data resources and tools. Interprets executes and documents complex test scripts using agreed methods and standards.Provides detailed analysis of all testing carried out on the environment ensuring all bugs risks and issues are logged correctly.Actively provides feedback to senior QA management which may result in new working practices or general QA improvements.Mentors coaches and coordinates a small group of less experienced QA Analysts ensuring they have the skills and knowledge in order to perform their roles.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
* Analyze the new feature request together with scrum team and product owner and provide early suggestions to be considered for feature development.
* Work with Scrum team on day to day basis as a quality checkpoint for all development work.
* Design simplified but effective test cases and keeping regression test packs up to date with new and amended software or services.
* Maintain and run automation test scripts
* Create and capture all test documentations
* Defect management
* Performance testing
* Suggest best practices to improve the quality of the software.
* Help developers with automation test scripts.
* Highlight issues and risks at early stages to stakeholders.


**About Your Skills**
* Good experience in agile testing environment and knowledge of all software testing methodologies e.g. functional testing, integration testing, user acceptance testing etc.
* University degree or equivalent preferably in Computer Science Engineering Mathematics or similar.
* ISTQB Foundation qualification or recognized country\-specific qualification desirable.
* Automation with knowledge of writing Gherkin scripts and some manual testing skills essential
* Tools in use include Selenium, Azure DevOps, Webdriver/TestNG/Cucumber, Java, RESTAssured, Jenkins, Postman, UFT and ALM Octane
* The person should have a knowledge of min. 1 programming language.
* Ability to work under pressure.
* Principles of Agile.
* Risk Based \& Model based testing knowledge


**NICE\-TO\-HAVE**
* Requirements Traceability Matrix skills
* DevOps/Continuous Integration knowledge


**What We Offer**
 We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.
   

  

 🏡
 **Flex Week:** 
 Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)
   

  

 ⏰
 **Flex Day:** 
 Make your workday suit your life and plans.
   

  

 🌎
 **Flex\-Location:** 
 Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.
   

  

 🌿
 **Employee Wellbeing:** 
 We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health \- a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.
